title.en: I left my $300k job to be my own boss. I would have never done it if I knew about this one thing
title.zh: 我辞去了价值 30 万美元的工作，自己当老板。如果我知道这一件事我就不会这么做

summary.en: Julian left a high-paying job to start his own business. He didn't anticipate the difficulties that would come.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Should you invest in shares, or property? Is university still worth it, or should you start your own business? With the path to financial security becoming less clear, Insight asks how aspirational people are getting ahead, and whether Australia is a good country to build wealth. Watch Insight episode Gettin' Rich on SBS or SBS On Demand.

I was raised in poverty in western Sydney by a single mum. At dinnertime, she would wait for my four siblings and me to finish eating, and then eat whatever was left over.

My mother had nothing but worked her absolute ass off doing everything from cleaning to hospitality to put us through school and to make sure we were always clothed and fed.

To me, she was proof of the Australian principle: you can achieve your financial goals and transform your life's circumstances if you are willing to make sacrifices and work hard.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Sure, I might not have all the things the other kids in school had, but it didn't matter where I started. If I worked hard, I could still get ahead and achieve the Australian dream .

Because I had to help my mum with our household bills, I started full-time work right out of high school as a junior finance broker on $38,000 while also studying web development full-time.

For the next 10 years, I worked almost every single weekend. I sacrificed and missed out on so much.

I didn't have a passport until I got married at 23; our honeymoon was the first time I went overseas.

I missed many family barbecues, events, and parties so I could set up my own life for my future family as well as support my mum.

I just knew that anything that I could do to help my mum would be worth it after seeing her struggle financially.

By the end of that decade when I was 27, I was running teams of over 20 people and earning upwards of $300k a year.

But I was working 80 hours a week, had no work-life balance, and felt like I was spending so much time building other people's businesses who didn't necessarily appreciate it.

The sacrifices no longer felt aligned with the reward, which made me think it could be different if I were my own boss.

So, in 2020, despite many people telling me it would fail, I decided to risk it all and start my own fintech business.

It was extremely scary starting from zero and paying myself potentially $0; I had no investors — just bootstrapping.

Twice I refinanced the family home, which my wife and I bought at age 22, drawing out hundreds of thousands in equity; I sold all the shares and crypto I had been investing in since I was young; I spent the money upfront that I received from Research and Development grants; and I took out $1+ million in...
body.zh: 您应该投资股票还是房地产？上大学还值得吗，还是应该自己创业？随着财务安全的道路变得越来越模糊，《洞察》询问了有抱负的人们如何取得成功，以及澳大利亚是否是一个积累财富的好国家。观看 SBS 或 SBS On Demand 上的《洞察》剧集《致富》。 我在悉尼西部的贫困中由一位单亲妈妈抚养长大。吃饭的时候，她会等我和四个兄弟姐妹吃完，然后再吃剩下的东西。 我母亲一无所有，除了拼尽全力做一切事情，从清洁到招待，供我们完成学业，并确保我们总是有衣有食。 对我来说，她证明了澳大利亚原则：如果你愿意做出牺牲并努力工作，你就可以实现你的财务目标并改变你的生活状况。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 当然，我可能没有学校里其他孩子所拥有的所有东西，但我从哪里开始并不重要。如果我努力工作，我仍然可以出人头地并实现澳大利亚梦。 因为我必须帮助妈妈支付家庭账单，所以我高中一毕业就开始全职工作，担任初级金融经纪人，年薪 38,000 美元，同时还全职学习网络开发。 在接下来的十年里，我几乎每个周末都工作。我牺牲了很多，也错过了很多。 我直到23岁结婚才拿到护照；我们的蜜月是我第一次出国。 我错过了很多家庭烧烤、活动和聚会，这样我就可以为未来的家庭建立自己的生活并支持我的妈妈。 我只知道，在看到妈妈经济困难后，我能为帮助她做的任何事情都是值得的。 到 20 世纪末，我 27 岁的时候，我已经管理着 20 多人的团队，年收入超过 30 万美元。 但我每周工作 80 小时，工作与生活无法平衡，感觉自己花了太多时间建设别人的企业，但别人不一定会欣赏。 牺牲不再与回报相一致，这让我觉得如果我是自己的老板，情况可能会有所不同。 因此，在 2020 年，尽管很多人告诉我这会失败，我还是决定冒一切风险，开始自己的金融科技业务。 从零开始并且可能给自己支付 0 美元是非常可怕的；我没有投资者——只是自力更生。 我曾两次为我和妻子在 22 岁时购买的家庭住宅进行再融资，提取了数十万的资产净值；我卖掉了我从小就投资的所有股票和加密货币；我预先花掉了从研发补助金中获得的资金；我拿出了1+00万美元...

title.en: It was Dolly Parton's proudest legacy. Now an Australian town must keep it alive
title.zh: 达莉·帕顿最引以为傲的遗产。现在，一个澳大利亚小镇必须将其延续下去

summary.en: In Australia, Dolly Parton's legacy extends far beyond music, touching the lives of 151,000 children.
summary.zh: 在澳大利亚，达莉·帕顿的遗产远不止音乐，它触及了15.1万名儿童的生活。

body.en:
In the regional NSW city of Tamworth, more than 3,000 children are reading more books because of Dolly Parton — a mark of Australia's connection to the legendary country singer, actor and philanthropist that runs deeper than one might initially think.

Parton died on Wednesday morning at 80. Tributes have poured in from around the world, but in Tamworth, the loss is more personal.

The city, dubbed the country music capital of Australia, holds an official sister-city bond with Parton's adopted hometown of Nashville and hosted Parton herself on her last Australian tour in 2014.

"It's an incredible nod to us that she would come here when most stars are looking for the big 70,000-seater auditoriums, whereas ours is 5,000 seats," Cheryl Brown, from the Tamworth Country Music Festival, told SBS News.

"So for her to come here, she certainly validated us as the country music capital and that saw us being an important part of country music here in Australia."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But it's her gift of the Imagination Library program, one of Parton's most personal philanthropic projects, that has really transformed Tamworth.

Founded in 1995 as a tribute to her illiterate father, Dolly Parton's Imagination Library is a free book-gifting program — now running across the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Ireland, and Australia — that mails new, age-appropriate books to children from birth until they turn five, completely free of charge.

It has gifted more than 300 million books to children since it started 31 years ago. In Australia, more than two million of those books have been delivered to 151,000 children across 480 communities since its launch here in 2013.

In Tamworth, where the program has run since 2019, its ambassador Lisa Rennie says it has fundamentally changed how children relate to reading and literacy.

"Children from birth to the age of five are eligible to receive the books, which are chosen by qualified speech pathologists and early literacy teachers," Rennie told SBS News.

"There are currently about 3,500 children on average on the program in the Tamworth region."

Since 2019, more than 98 per cent of children born in Tamworth have been enrolled.

Families sign up at no cost, ensuring accessibility for those experiencing disadvantage — books are posted to each home each month, and caregivers are also given reading guidance sheets to help foster lifelong reading in families.

About 70 per cent of those books are by Australian authors and 10 per cent by First Nations authors.

title.en: The antisemitism royal commission hearings are over. What happens now?
title.zh: 反犹太主义皇家委员会听证会结束了。现在会发生什么？

summary.en: After months of evidence, the antisemitism royal commission will enter its final phase before delivering a report in December.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
After more than 340 witnesses were called to give evidence across 62 days, the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion hearings have concluded.

The inquiry was established in response to the Bondi Beach terror attack, in which 15 people were killed during a Hanukkah celebration last December. It was tasked with investigating the circumstances of the attack, the impact of antisemitism on Jewish Australians and how social cohesion can be promoted.

The ninth and final block of hearings concluded on Wednesday , after examining how social cohesion could be understood, measured and promoted.

The inquiry will now turn to preparation of a final report, authored by commissioner Virginia Bell, who will summarise submissions, analyse evidence, establish facts and make recommendations.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As with the interim report released in April, some material may remain confidential because of national security concerns or to avoid prejudicing criminal proceedings.

The sole surviving alleged gunman, Naveed Akram, has been charged with terror and murder offences, in a case that is separate from the commission. He has yet to enter a plea.

The commission does not determine criminal guilt or impose criminal penalties. It can, however, refer matters to law enforcement or prosecuting authorities.

Its recommendations will be considered by governments, which will decide whether and how to implement them.

Bell was due to submit her final report by 14 December — the one-year anniversary of the shooting — but she has requested a four-day deadline extension.

That request was in response to concern from Australia's Jewish community that the report coming out on the day of the anniversary of the attack would be a distraction from memorials.

Leaders of Australia's Jewish community expressed gratitude for those who gave evidence at the commission, often at a personal cost.

The commission heard directly from roughly 14,000 community members through evidence submitted in person and in writing, Bell said.

Executive Council of Australian Jewry co-chief Peter Werheim said the community had put its heart and soul into the commission.

"Hundreds of people have told the truth about their everyday experience of antisemitism, and thousands more have provided detailed accounts through written submissions. We thank everyone who has made a contribution. The commissioner has a great deal of evidence to weigh, and we trust her to do that carefully."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 在 62 天内传唤了 340 多名证人提供证据后，皇家反犹太主义和社会凝聚力委员会听证会结束了。 该调查是为了回应去年 12 月光明节庆祝活动期间发生的邦迪海滩恐怖袭击事件，造成 15 人死亡。它的任务是调查袭击的情况、反犹太主义对犹太澳大利亚人的影响以及如何促进社会凝聚力。 在审查了如何理解、衡量和促进社会凝聚力后，第九次也是最后一次听证会于周三结束。 调查现在将转向准备一份由专员弗吉尼亚·贝尔撰写的最终报告，她将总结提交的意见，分析证据，确定事实并提出建议。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 与四月份发布的中期报告一样，出于国家安全考虑或避免损害刑事诉讼，某些材料可能会保持机密。 唯一幸存的枪手纳维德·阿克兰 (Naveed Akram) 被指控犯有恐怖罪和谋杀罪，该案件与该委员会无关。他尚未提出抗辩。 该委员会不确定刑事罪名或判处刑事处罚。但是，它可以将问题提交给执法机构或检察机关。 其建议将由各国政府考虑，并决定是否以及如何实施这些建议。 贝尔原定于 12 月 14 日（枪击事件一周年纪念日）之前提交最终报告，但她请求将截止日期延长四天。 这一要求是为了回应澳大利亚犹太社区的担忧，即在袭击周年纪念日发布的报告会分散人们对纪念活动的注意力。 澳大利亚犹太社区的领导人对那些在委员会提供证据的人表示感谢，而这些证据往往是由个人付出的。 贝尔说，委员会通过亲自和书面提交的证据直接听取了大约 14,000 名社区成员的意见。 澳大利亚犹太人执行委员会联席主席彼得·韦海姆 (Peter Werheim) 表示，社区已全身心投入该委员会。 “数百人讲述了他们日常反犹太主义经历的真相，还有数千人通过书面意见提供了详细的叙述。我们感谢所有做出贡献的人。专员有大量证据需要权衡，我们相信她会谨慎行事。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: A $1.4 billion question: The case for a new tax on Australians
title.zh: 14亿澳元的问题：澳大利亚征收新税的理由

summary.en: A Griffith University study published in BMJ Public Health suggests that a 20% tax on sugary drinks could prevent 3.7 million cases of tooth decay and 115,000 cases of tooth loss in Australia over 25 years. The proposed levy would generate revenue that could be used to fund universal dental care and strengthen general...
summary.zh: 发表在《英国医学杂志·公共卫生》上的格里菲斯大学的一项研究建议，对含糖饮料征收20%的税，可以在25年内为澳大利亚预防370万例龋齿和11.5万例牙齿脱落。拟议的征税将产生收入，可用于资助全民牙科保健并加强普通医疗服务。

body.en:
A Griffith University study published in BMJ Public Health on Wednesday found a levy applied to non-alcoholic drinks with added sugar, such as soft drinks and most juices, could prevent 3.7 million cases of tooth decay, 191,000 cases of gum disease, and 115,000 cases of complete tooth loss across Australia over the next 25 years.

The study suggested that tax revenue could be used to strengthen health services and to implement a universal health care approach to dental care, but co-author Lennert Veerman said the benefits would extend beyond oral health.

"The study also estimates a 20 per cent sugar tax would generate approximately half a million health-adjusted life years for the 2019 Australian population over their lifetime, both from dental health improvements and reductions in weight-related illness," the Griffith University public health professor said.

As of 2017–2018, approximately 9.1 per cent of Australians adults reported drinking sugar-sweetened beverages every day, while nearly one-third of Australians aged 15 and older had untreated tooth decay or cavities, according to the study.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Using a computer-based simulation, researchers found that for every 1 per cent increase in the price of sugar-sweetened drinks, consumption was expected to drop by 1.2 per cent.

Assuming a 20 per cent tax is passed on in full to consumers, the study predicted the price increase would result in a 24 per cent reduction in consumption.

Marco Peres from SingHealth Duke-NUS in Singapore said the findings highlighted the oral health benefits of sugar taxes.

"It does not rely solely on individuals changing their behaviour but helps create an environment in which healthier choices become easier.

"This is particularly important if we want prevention strategies to reach the whole population and reduce health inequalities." 

Oral diseases are a growing public health concern, affecting approximately 3.5 billion people globally.

The study found that oral diseases contributed to 2.4 per cent of Australia’s total health burden — the impact of a health problem on a population — and ranked among the top 10 diseases.

According to the World Health Organization, 116 countries have an excise tax on at least one type of sugar-sweetened beverage. The study notes there is a high level of support among the Australian public for policies that reduce sugar intake.

In 2018, the United Kingdom introduced a tax of 19.4 or 25.9 pence per litre, depending on the sugar content of beverages.

It reminds us that national well-being is often preserved when leaders listen to the 'abundance of counselors' who seek the common good. title.en: Northern Territory MP Luke Gosling steps down as defence envoy after assault charge
title.zh: 北领地议员卢克·戈斯林因被控袭击而辞去国防特使职务

summary.en: Gosling says he "categorically denies" the charges against him and will defend himself in court.
summary.zh: 戈斯林表示他“断然否认”对他的指控，并将出庭为自己辩护。

body.en:
A Labor politician in the Northern Territory has stood aside from an envoy role after he was charged by police for a second time.

Darwin-based Luke Gosling, who holds the federal seat of Solomon, is facing fresh accusations of breaching his bail conditions.

He was originally charged in July with the assault of Northern Territory Administrator David Connolly, the jurisdiction's equivalent to a state governor.

In a statement on Wednesday, Gosling announced his decision to step down until the matters have been dealt with in court.

"Due to the ongoing media attention and the distraction this is causing to the business of government, I have decided to temporarily stand aside as Special Envoy for Defence, Veterans' Affairs and Northern Australia," Gosling said in a post on social media.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I am more committed than ever to my role serving the people of Darwin and Palmerston."

Gosling vowed to "rigorously" defend himself against the charges in court and strongly denies the allegations.

Gosling was charged on Tuesday with one count of breach of bail and is due to appear in Darwin Local Court on 30 September.

Earlier on Wednesday, Opposition leader Angus Taylor said the prime minister faced an even "stronger test" of his leadership since charges were first laid.

"[Anthony Albanese] must act. It's completely unacceptable for a second charge to be placed on Luke Gosling. He should be stood down," he told ABC News Breakfast.

"Presumption of innocence is important in our system, but he should be stood down whilst these proceedings continue."

The assault is alleged to have occurred at the NT Thailand Grand Festival in Darwin on 18 July, with Gosling posting photos from the event on social media that day.

"You've gotta get punted, mate. I don't know, let's see what Mr Albanese does," he told News24.

NT Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro said the matter was for Albanese to deal with.

"Ultimately, if all of these allegations are true, it clearly doesn't meet the expectation of our community," she told ABC radio.

Gosling's lawyer, Marty Aust, has previously criticised police for arresting the politician at his home rather than issuing him a summons or notice to appear.

As part of his bail conditions, Gosling is banned from going within 50 metres of the NT's Government House building and must give the administrator's office 48 hours' notice before attending any event where the two men would be present.

If they are at an event together, the Labor politician must not be within 15m of Connolly.

body.zh: 北领地的一名工党政治家在第二次受到警方指控后辞去了特使职务。 居住在达尔文的所罗门联邦议席卢克·高斯林正面临违反保释条件的新指控。 他最初于 7 月被指控袭击北领地行政长官戴维·康诺利 (David Connolly)，后者相当于该司法管辖区的州长。 高斯林在周三的一份声明中宣布，他决定辞职，直到此事在法庭上得到解决。 高斯林在社交媒体上发帖称：“由于媒体的持续关注以及这对政府事务造成的干扰，我决定暂时辞去国防、退伍军人事务和北澳大利亚特使的职务。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我比以往任何时候都更加致力于为达尔文和帕默斯顿人民服务。” 高斯林发誓要在法庭上“严格”为自己辩护，并强烈否认这些指控。 高斯林周二被指控一项违反保释罪，将于 9 月 30 日在达尔文地方法院出庭。 周三早些时候，反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒表示，自首次提出指控以来，总理的领导力面临着“更强有力的考验”。 “[安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯]必须采取行动。对卢克·高斯林提出第二项指控是完全不可接受的。他应该被停职，”他告诉美国广播公司早餐新闻。 “无罪推定在我们的制度中很重要，但在这些诉讼继续进行期间，他应该被停职。” 据称，这起袭击事件发生在 7 月 18 日达尔文举行的北领地泰国盛大节日期间，高斯林当天在社交媒体上发布了该活动的照片。 “你一定会被踢的，伙计。我不知道，让我们看看阿尔巴尼斯先生会做什么，”他告诉 News24。 北领地首席部长 Lia Finocchiaro 表示，此事由 Albanese 处理。 “最终，如果所有这些指控都是真的，那显然不符合我们社区的期望，”她告诉美国广播公司电台。 高斯林的律师马蒂·奥斯特此前批评警方在他家中逮捕了这位政客，而不是向他发出传票或出庭通知。 作为保释条件的一部分，高斯林被禁止进入北领地总督府大楼 50 米范围内，并且必须在参加两人出席的任何活动之前提前 48 小时通知管理员办公室。 如果工党政客一起参加活动，则工党政治家不得距离康诺利 15m 以内。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

It is understood that two 34-year-old mothers took their children to the APM shopping mall in Kwun Tong at around 4pm, when an argument broke out over the use of play facilities. title.en: North Korea to ‘bring joy’ to Kim with 100 athletes at Asian Games
title.zh: 朝鲜将携100名运动员参加亚运会为金正恩“带来欢乐”

summary.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: North Korea will send about 100 athletes to compete across 14 sports at the Asian Games in Japan next month, a senior official said, aiming to “bring joy to Marshal Kim Jong Un”. This picture taken on August 16, 2026 and released by North Korea’s official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) via KNS on August 17, 2026 shows North Korean leader Kim Jong Un (centre R) and his daughter Kim Ju Ae watching swimming and diving competitions, to mark the 81st anniversary of the end of World War II in Pyongyang. Photo: KCNA via KNS/AFP. The nuclear-armed state suspended participation in international sporting competitions during the Covid pandemic but returned at the Asian Games in China in 2023 and also took part in the Paris Olympics. The team for the regional Games in Nagoya and the Aichi region includes two Japan-based ethnic Koreans competing in women’s football and karate, said Ko Chol Ho, secretary general of North Korea’s Olympic committee. “Our delegation will send more than 100 athletes to compete in 14 sports, including men’s and women’s football, weightlifting, boxing and wrestling,” Ko told Choson Sinbo, a pro-North Korean publication based in Japan, during an interview in Pyongyang. Kim Jong Un. File photo: USGov. “We are making every effort, driven by a strong desire to live up to the expectations of our country and people by achieving even greater results at the upcoming Games,” the official said, in remarks published Tuesday. He noted that the delegation would be smaller than the one sent to the Hangzhou Games of 2023 but said he hoped it would win more medals. Authoritarian North Korea won 11 golds last time, half of them in weightlifting. The official said that morale among the athletes was high for the event, which runs from September 19 to October 4, and they were motivated to win for their leader. “Our athletes are training tirelessly every day, determined to bring joy to Marshal Kim,” he said. North Korea has recently been hurling criticism at Japan, a former regional colonial power, over what Pyongyang describes as its remilitarisation.
body.zh: 一名高级官员表示，朝鲜将派出约 100 名运动员参加下个月在日本举行的亚运会，参加 14 个项目的比赛，旨在“为金正恩元帅带来欢乐”。这张拍摄于 2026 年 8 月 16 日、朝鲜官方朝中社 (KCNA) 通过 KNS 于 2026 年 8 月 17 日发布的照片​​显示，朝鲜领导人金正恩（中右）和他的女儿金珠爱正在观看游泳和跳水比赛，以纪念平壤第二次世界大战结束 81 周年。照片：朝中社/法新社。这个拥有核武器的国家在新冠病毒大流行期间暂停了参加国际体育比赛，但在 2023 年中国亚运会上回归，还参加了巴黎奥运会。朝鲜奥委会秘书长高哲浩表示，参加名古屋和爱知地区地区运动会的代表队包括两名居住在日本的朝鲜族选手，她们参加女子足球和空手道比赛。 “我们代表团将派出100多名运动员参加14个项目的比赛，包括男女足球、举重、拳击和摔跤，”高在平壤接受采访时告诉日本亲朝鲜出版物《朝鲜新报》。金正恩.资料图：美国政府。这位官员在周二发表的讲话中表示：“我们正在尽一切努力，强烈希望在即将到来的奥运会上取得更好的成绩，不辜负我们国家和人民的期望。”他指出，代表团规模将比参加 2023 年杭州奥运会的代表团规模要小，但他表示希望代表团能赢得更多奖牌。独裁的朝鲜上次赢得了 11 枚金牌，其中一半是举重金牌。这位官员表示，在9月19日至10月4日举行的这项赛事中，运动员们士气高昂，他们有动力为自己的领袖赢得胜利。 “我们的运动员每天都在不知疲倦地训练，决心为金元帅带来欢乐，”他说。朝鲜最近一直对前地区殖民国家日本提出批评，平壤称其为重新军事化。

title.en: Hong Kong’s first Chinese medicine hospital to offer inpatient services from December
title.zh: 香港首间中医院12月起提供住院服务

summary.en: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong will begin offering hospitalisation services in December, with fees starting at three times those of public hospitals. The Tseung Kwan O facility, which opened last December, will launch 24-hour inpatient care from December 11,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong will begin offering hospitalisation services in December, with fees starting at three times those of public hospitals. The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong. Photo: GovHK. The Tseung Kwan O facility, which opened last December, will launch 24-hour inpatient care from December 11, authorities said on Tuesday. It currently provides only outpatient and day-patient services. A total of 93 beds will be made available. This includes 60 government-subsidised beds, available to eligible Hong Kong residents, as well as 33 non-subsidised ones. The hospital will also provide 20 beds under its Clinical Trial and Research Centre, and two high-dependency beds for patients who require closer observation and nursing care. The total number of beds is expected to reach 400 by the end of 2030. The city’s first hospital dedicated to traditional Chinese medicine, the facility operates under a public-private partnership model. It is managed by a company set up by Hong Kong Baptist University, which was selected as the project contractor in 2021 following a government tender process. Hong Kong Baptist University. Photo: GovHK. The hospital uses two fee structures: one for subsidised services and another for more expensive “market-oriented services.” Inpatient services will cost $980 under the subsidised scheme – more than three times the day charge for a public hospital bed, which is currently priced at HK$300. For non-subsidised beds, fees range from HK$810 to HK$3,100 per day, depending on the room type. These rates do not include medical attendance or consultation, which start from HK$560 per visit. More services expanded In addition to launching inpatient services, the hospital will expand existing outpatient services, including those offered in its radiological diagnostic and pathology departments. The Chinese Medicine Hospital of Hong Kong. Photo: GovHK. The hospital will also introduce 10 new special disease programmes in September and November, covering conditions such as eczema, Parkinson’s disease, and functional gastrointestinal disorders. “By leveraging the strengths of Chinese medicine and the complementary advantages of Chinese and Western medicine, the multidisciplinary team of the hospital will provide patients with highly effective treatment to enhance clinical outcomes,” the government said in a statement . Authorities predict that annual outpatient attendance will rise from 140,000 in the first year of operation to over 260,000 in the second year.

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? body.en: While quantum computing could be the future, it is currently plagued by finicky hardware. To make the technology practical, researchers must demonstrate that it consistently and continuously works and performs at scale. In a new study, published in Physical Review Letters, researchers at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) and the Ion Storage Group at the National Institute of Standards and Technology in Boulder, Colorado, created a robust process for entangling trapped-ion qubits. The result means better building blocks for ion-based quantum computers.

title.en: Ocean antacid trials test plankton response in 8,000-liter seawater enclosures
title.zh: 海洋抗酸剂试验测试 8,000 升海水围栏中浮游生物的反应

summary.en: All the forests in the world pale in comparison to the ocean when it comes to absorbing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. The ocean is the world's largest natural carbon sink, absorbing about a quarter of all CO2 emissions every year (and most of the excess heat trapped in...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

All the forests in the world pale in comparison to the ocean when it comes to absorbing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. The ocean is the world's largest natural carbon sink, absorbing about a quarter of all CO 2 emissions every year (and most of the excess heat trapped in Earth's atmosphere from greenhouse gases).

For one, there are natural limits to how much carbon the ocean can absorb and how quickly. Second, as CO 2 dissolves in the ocean, it reacts with seawater. Those reactions release hydrogen ions, which make the water more acidic.

Since the Industrial Revolution, the surface ocean has become 30% more acidic on average, to the point that it's making life hard for organisms that build chalk-like shells and skeletons—including corals, coccolithophores and young oysters.

Adding minerals that alter the chemistry of seawater, in a process called ocean alkalinity enhancement (OAE), is a proposed solution to address both of these challenges. As a "marine carbon dioxide removal" strategy, OAE would amplify natural processes in the ocean to increase its ability to absorb CO 2 . An added benefit would be countering acidification.

Again, there is a caveat. As a relatively new idea that hasn't been tested widely at scale, there are still significant questions about how these chemical changes would affect marine life. That includes the plant-like phytoplankton that form the base of the marine food web and drive many of the ocean's most important biogeochemical processes.

Steve Archer, a senior research scientist at Bigelow Laboratory for Ocean Sciences, is working with a team of researchers from around the world to help fill those knowledge gaps. Over the past five years, they've run several large-scale experiments using an isolated system called a mesocosm that replicates natural conditions without influencing the ocean directly. These experiments are helping scientists understand the potential biological impacts and nuances of OAE, including its effect on plankton.

"There are already companies proposing to do this, but they're going into it without sufficient information on what's going to happen," Archer said. "There are some important questions that we're trying to answer to ensure we have informed, science-based decision-making when it comes to OAE and marine carbon dioxide removal."

OAE works on a rather basic principle. The goal is to accelerate natural rock weathering by adding crushed minerals to seawater. Archer describes it as "an antacid for the ocean."

"It's just mimicking a natural process, which is how the pH of the ocean has been maintained over...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在吸收大气中的二氧化碳方面，世界上所有的森林与海洋相比都相形见绌。海洋是世界上最大的天然碳汇，每年吸收大约四分之一的CO 2 排放量（以及地球大气中温室气体中捕获的大部分多余热量）。 其一，海洋吸收碳的量和速度存在自然限制。其次，当CO 2 溶解在海洋中时，它会与海水发生反应。这些反应释放出氢离子，使水变得更加酸性。 自工业革命以来，海洋表层的酸度平均增加了 30%，这使得那些能够形成白垩状外壳和骨骼的生物体（包括珊瑚、颗石藻和幼牡蛎）的生存变得困难。 在称为海洋碱度增强（OAE）的过程中添加改变海水化学性质的矿物质是解决这两个挑战的拟议解决方案。作为一项“海洋二氧化碳去除”策略，OAE 将放大海洋中的自然过程，以提高其吸收 CO 2 的能力。另一个好处是对抗酸化。 再次，有一个警告。作为一个尚未大规模测试的相对较新的想法，这些化学变化将如何影响海洋生物仍然存在重大问题。其中包括形成海洋食物网基础并驱动许多海洋最重要的生物地球化学过程的类植物浮游植物。 毕格罗海洋科学实验室的高级研究科学家史蒂夫·阿彻（Steve Archer）正在与来自世界各地的研究人员团队合作，帮助填补这些知识空白。在过去的五年里，他们使用一种称为中宇宙的孤立系统进行了几次大规模实验，该系统复制了自然条件，而不直接影响海洋。这些实验正在帮助科学家了解 OAE 的潜在生物影响和细微差别，包括其对浮游生物的影响。 “已经有公司提议这样做，但他们在没有足够信息的情况下就开始这样做，”阿彻说。 “我们正在尝试回答一些重要问题，以确保我们在 OAE 和海洋二氧化碳清除方面做出明智、基于科学的决策。” OAE 的工作原理相当基本。目标是通过在海水中添加碎矿物质来加速自然岩石风化。阿彻将其描述为“海洋的抗酸剂”。 “这只是模仿一个自然过程，这就是海洋 pH 值长期保持的方式......

title.en: We discovered rare dinosaur tracks from the Coniacian age near Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia
title.zh: 我们在不列颠哥伦比亚省塔布勒岭附近发现了来自科尼亚克时代的罕见恐龙足迹

summary.en: Imagine the Western Plains of North America, from Texas to Alaska, submerged under a broad, shallow seaway. To the west lay the ancestral Rocky Mountains. To the east were low-lying plains traversed by large, sluggish rivers.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Imagine the Western Plains of North America, from Texas to Alaska, submerged under a broad, shallow seaway. To the west lay the ancestral Rocky Mountains. To the east were low-lying plains traversed by large, sluggish rivers.

This was the landscape of North America in the mid-Cretaceous period—a geological age spanning 105–75 million years ago—when the global sea level was around 100 meters (328 feet) higher than it is now .

A high concentration of atmospheric carbon dioxide, due to massive volcanism, created a "greenhouse" climate such that Earth lacked significant polar ice caps . Alaska and Antarctica enjoyed temperate climates.

The record of dinosaur bones and tracks from this time in North America is sparse, especially from the Coniacian age—a substage of this Cretaceous period spanning 89.75–86.5 million years ago.

We have discovered the first Canadian dinosaur tracks from this Coniacian age in the Tumbler Ridge area of northeastern British Columbia.

One of us, Guy Plint, first noticed these tracks in 1988. However, the remote nature of the site, best accessed by helicopter, delayed further investigation until 2022, when we were able to begin a more comprehensive study together. The findings were recently published in Historical Biology .

North America has yielded an abundant record of dinosaurs , including both skeletal material and tracks. Because dinosaur tracks can only be made and preserved in nonmarine, terrestrial sediments, most North American tracks are found in sedimentary rocks laid down by rivers that drained the Rocky Mountains.

Their sediment load gradually built deltas and coastal plains along the western margin of the Interior Seaway .

Over millions of years, sea level slowly rose and fell, alternately narrowing and widening the coastal plain.

The late Cenomanian, Turonian, Coniacian and Santonian stages of the Cretaceous period —between about 95 and 84 million years ago—were times of exceptionally high sea levels, when shorelines were pushed westward, lapping against the foothills of the Rocky Mountains .

In western Canada, Coniacian rocks are entirely marine, with the exception of the small Tumbler Ridge area of northeastern British Columbia.

Here, a river system built a delta that protruded eastward into the seaway. The deposits of that ancient delta are called the Marshybank Formation, which, critically, includes some terrestrial strata that preserve the tracks we found.

title.en: European city climate plans underuse green spaces despite adaptation benefits, finds study
title.zh: 研究发现，欧洲城市气候计划尽管有适应效益，但仍未充分利用绿色空间

summary.en: Green spaces could play a key role in helping cities cope with the effects of climate change, yet they still play only a minor role in climate strategies. These were the findings of researchers at Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg (MLU) and Justus Liebig University...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Green spaces could play a key role in helping cities cope with the effects of climate change, yet they still play only a minor role in climate strategies. These were the findings of researchers at Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg (MLU) and Justus Liebig University Giessen (JLU), who analyzed the climate strategies of 25 major European cities.

Of the approximately 2,500 individual measures evaluated by the team, only 11.6% included green spaces and urban open spaces. Cities mainly focus on measures to reduce or prevent greenhouse gas emissions. The study was published in the journal Progress in Disaster Science .

Cities are particularly hard hit by storms, heavy rain and heat waves because of their dense development, large populations and extensive paved surfaces. Urban green spaces could help alleviate these effects by absorbing rainwater and lowering temperatures.

"Although the positive effects of urban green spaces have been thoroughly studied and are well known, this knowledge is not consistently reflected in the climate strategy documents of many large European cities," says senior lecturer PD Dr. Marcin Spyra from the Institute of Geosciences and Geography at MLU.

The researchers analyzed the planning reports of 25 European capitals and other large cities. The team categorized the individual measures described in the plans according to their type, objective and use of green spaces and other urban open spaces.

"One key positive is that climate action is a strategic priority in almost all urban development plans, with a wide range of climate measures," Spyra says. The analysis also revealed a predominance of measures aimed at reducing harmful greenhouse gas emissions, known as climate mitigation, in most plans.

"The proportion of measures aimed at protecting against the already noticeable consequences of climate change is increasing. Green spaces feature much more prominently in adaptation strategies than in plans focused solely on mitigation. However, they remain underrepresented overall," says Dr. Victoria Dietze from JLU.

The scientists identified significant differences between the cities they analyzed. Vienna incorporated green spaces and urban open spaces more extensively than any of the other cities in the study, with 30 such measures. Stockholm, on the other hand, was the only city without a single such measure, according to the analysis. Instead, the Swedish capital relies heavily on measures that reduce emissions.

title.en: Reference genome of the Saimaa ringed seal released
title.zh: 塞马环斑海豹参考基因组发布

summary.en: Researchers at the University of Eastern Finland and the University of Oulu have produced the first chromosome-level reference genome for the Saimaa ringed seal. The sequence of every chromosome in the seal's entire genome has now been read and assembled into virtual maps,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers at the University of Eastern Finland and the University of Oulu have produced the first chromosome-level reference genome for the Saimaa ringed seal. The sequence of every chromosome in the seal's entire genome has now been read and assembled into virtual maps, including its gene content.

The genome provides a unique perspective on the species' genetic makeup and adaptation to its freshwater environment. It also supports evidence-based conservation. The work was presented on the preprint server bioRxiv .

A reference genome is a model—as the name suggests—a point of comparison against which genomic data from other individuals can be analyzed. It is a carefully assembled representation of what the genome of a species typically looks like, how it is organized into chromosomes, the order of its DNA sequences and which genes it contains.

"Reference genomes are like maps of a species' genetic information," explains professor Jaakko Pohjoismäki from the University of Eastern Finland.

"A map is only a representation of the terrain, but it still helps us navigate. In the same way, a reference genome helps researchers understand where different genes are located and how individuals differ from one another genetically. Detailed information about genes can also reveal functional differences between species."

Unlike most reference genomes, the newly published genome comes from a living Saimaa ringed seal. The male seal Tuukka was captured in 2023 as part of genetic translocations aimed at safeguarding the remaining genetic diversity of the population. A small skin sample was collected from Tuukka, from which a cell line was established in the laboratory. This provided high-quality DNA with the precision required to determine the sequence of the genome.

The cell line preserves Tuukka's unique genetic makeup in living form, benefiting not only current research and conservation efforts but also future generations of researchers.

The Saimaa ringed seal genome is 2.35 billion base pairs long and consists of 17 chromosomes, including the sex chromosomes. It contains approximately 21,800 genes, slightly more than the human genome does.

Genomic comparisons revealed several genetic differences that may be associated with adaptation to a freshwater environment. Examples include genes involved in ion transport and kidney function, which are important for maintaining salt and water balance in freshwater. Differences in olfactory receptors among species may also reflect adaptation to the environmental conditions of Lake Saimaa.

title.en: Does AI shape decisions before we do? Researcher questions what 'human in the loop' really means
title.zh: 人工智能会先于我们制定决策吗？研究人员质疑“循环中的人”的真正含义

summary.en: Artificial intelligence is often discussed with a simple safeguard in mind: Keep a human in the loop. But what happens when AI is already shaping the information, options and recommendations that inform a decision?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Artificial intelligence is often discussed with a simple safeguard in mind: Keep a human in the loop. But what happens when AI is already shaping the information, options and recommendations that inform a decision?

That question is part of new research by Lorien Jordan, an assistant professor in the USF College of Education. In a recently published article, Jordan examines recent disputes involving major AI companies and the U.S. Department of Defense, challenging the idea that AI ethics can be reduced to choosing one company or platform over another. The research is published in the journal Qualitative Inquiry .

The debate between Anthropic and the Defense Department over how its AI could be used illustrates the question: Even when a human remains responsible for the final decision, what happens when AI has already shaped the information behind it? Jordan's research looks at the broader systems that connect AI technologies to universities, publishers and researchers.

"One of the things that surprised me and that I will continue to research is how we always say we need a human in the loop when we use AI, but as we're scaling decisions so quickly and so massively, what does it mean to be responsible for the decisions that follow if the information reaching a researcher has already been shaped by the systems behind an AI tool?"

Her research considers the larger systems behind AI tools and their "heritage"—platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude are based on frontier large language models and built on shared research and techniques.

"I think awareness is an important aspect of AI," she said. "Many debate whether one company appears more 'responsible' than another, but they are often overlooking the broader infrastructures that connect these technologies."

The question extends beyond research, as AI is increasingly being used to assist decision-making in fields ranging from health care and education to business and national security.

For qualitative researchers like Jordan, the findings call for greater awareness of the systems in which AI research and use are already embedded. To further explore these concepts, she is developing a new study to analyze the choices researchers make with AI that will allow participants to see how AI interprets their words in real time.

Jordan's work contributes to a growing body of research examining the ethical implications of AI and the larger systems and relationships that make these technologies possible.

Lorien S. Jordan, Qualitative Ethics and the AI War Machine, Qualitative Inquiry (2026). DOI: 10.1177/10778004261468239

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 人们在讨论人工智能时通常会考虑到一个简单的保障措施：让人类了解情况。但是，当人工智能已经形成了为决策提供信息、选项和建议时，会发生什么呢？ 这个问题是南佛罗里达大学教育学院助理教授 Lorien Jordan 的新研究的一部分。在最近发表的一篇文章中，乔丹研究了最近涉及主要人工智能公司和美国国防部的纠纷，挑战了人工智能道德可以简化为选择一家公司或平台而不是另一家公司或平台的观点。该研究发表在《定性调查》杂志上。 Anthropic 和国防部之间关于如何使用人工智能的争论说明了一个问题：即使人类仍然对最终决定负责，但当人工智能已经塑造了其背后的信息时会发生什么？乔丹的研究着眼于将人工智能技术与大学、出版商和研究人员连接起来的更广泛的系统。 “令我惊讶且我将继续研究的一件事是，当我们使用人工智能时，我们总是说我们需要一个人参与其中，但随着我们如此迅速和大规模地扩展决策，如果到达研究人员的信息已经由人工智能工具背后的系统塑造，那么对随后的决策负责意味着什么？” 她的研究考虑了人工智能工具背后的更大系统及其“遗产”——ChatGPT 和 Claude 等平台基于前沿大型语言模型，并建立在共享研究和技术的基础上。 “我认为意识是人工智能的一个重要方面，”她说。 “许多人争论一家公司是否比另一家公司显得更‘负责任’，但他们往往忽视了连接这些技术的更广泛的基础设施。” 这个问题超出了研究范围，因为人工智能越来越多地被用来协助从医疗保健和教育到商业和国家安全等领域的决策。 对于像乔丹这样的定性研究人员来说，这些发现要求提高对人工智能研究和使用已经嵌入的系统的认识。为了进一步探索这些概念，她正在开展一项新研究来分析研究人员使用人工智能做出的选择，让参与者了解人工智能如何实时解释他们的话语。 乔丹的工作为越来越多的研究做出了贡献，这些研究审视人工智能的伦理影响以及使这些技术成为可能的更大的系统和关系。 Lorien S. title.en: Dozens of US and Canadian citizens missing after flash flooding in Nepal
title.zh: 尼泊尔山洪爆发，数十名美国和加拿大公民失踪

summary.en: They are among hundreds of people still unaccounted for, with authorities for both countries saying they are closely monitoring the situation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Dozens of Americans and Canadians are among hundreds of people who are missing following a deadly flash flood and mudslide near the Nepal-Tibet border, Nepali authorities say.

More than 150 people are so far known to have died, according to the authorities.

The US State Department said it was aware that Americans were impacted by Wednesday's floods but did not provide numbers.

It added that the US embassy in Nepal is working closely with local tour agencies and authorities to assist affected Americans, a spokesperson said.

Canada's foreign office said it was also monitoring developments and was ready to provide assistance if needed.

According to Nepal police, 579 tourists are missing - including 466 who are foreign nationals and from 28 different countries.

They include 54 people from the US, more than 100 from India, 33 from the UK and more than 100 from Nepal.

The State Department did not provide figures or additional details regarding the Americans affected for privacy reasons.

A further 24 Canadians are also missing, a Nepal Tourist Board spokesperson said.

Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney said his government was closely following the situation.

"As rescue efforts continue, Canada stands ready to provide support," Carney wrote on X.

The prime minister said all Canadians in the region should sign up for Registration of Canadians Abroad, a free service that lets the federal government contact and assist citizens during an emergency in other countries.

State media in China, which controls Tibet, reported three dead and 265 missing there. CCTV from Tibet showed a wall of water and mud hitting buildings at a border crossing.

Initial reports from Nepal had suggested that an earthquake may have triggered the ice avalanche and landslide.

But the US Geological Survey, which studies earthquakes, has now said that further analysis indicates "that the seismic energy was instead generated by a landslide" by itself.

Landslides or avalanches can have various triggers. One possibility is that water - either from rainfall or melting ice - may have destabilised the ground or ice.

Climate change is known to be driving faster glacier melt in the Hindu Kush Himalaya region, but scientists say it is too soon to pinpoint its role in this specific event.

The flash flooding swept away entire communities. Roads and bridges worth more than 15bn Nepalese rupees (£72.18m, $98.33m) were damaged by the floods, a government official told BBC Nepali, citing initial estimates.

The US Embassy in Nepal said it remained in close contact with Nepali authorities.

"We are deeply saddened by the tragic loss of life and devastation caused by the Bhote Koshi flood that struck Rasuwa district and communities downstream," it said in a statement posted on social...
body.zh: 尼泊尔当局称，尼泊尔和西藏边境附近发生致命的山洪和泥石流，造成数百人失踪，其中包括数十名美国人和加拿大人。 据当局称，目前已知已有 150 多人死亡。 美国国务院表示，它知道美国人受到周三洪水的影响，但没有提供具体数字。 发言人表示，美国驻尼泊尔大使馆正在与当地旅行社和当局密切合作，以协助受影响的美国人。 加拿大外交部表示，它也在监测事态发展，并准备在需要时提供援助。 据尼泊尔警方称，共有 579 名游客失踪，其中 466 名是来自 28 个不同国家的外国人。 其中美国54人，印度100多人，英国33人，尼泊尔100多人。 出于隐私原因，国务院没有提供有关受影响美国人的数据或其他详细信息。 尼泊尔旅游局发言人称，另有 24 名加拿大人失踪。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示，加拿大政府正在密切关注事态发展。 卡尼在 X 上写道：“随着救援工作的继续，加拿大随时准备提供支持。” 总理表示，该地区的所有加拿大人都应该注册海外加拿大人登记，这是一项免费服务，让联邦政府在其他国家发生紧急情况时能够联系和协助公民。 控制西藏的中国官方媒体报道说，西藏有 3 人死亡、265 人失踪。来自西藏的闭路电视显示，一道水墙和泥浆击中了边境口岸的建筑物。 来自尼泊尔的初步报告表明，地震可能引发了冰雪崩和山体滑坡。 但研究地震的美国地质调查局现在表示，进一步的分析表明“地震能量是由山体滑坡本身产生的”。 山体滑坡或雪崩可能有多种诱因。一种可能性是，来自降雨或融化冰的水可能破坏了地面或冰的稳定。 众所周知，气候变化正在推动兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川融化速度加快，但科学家表示，现在确定气候变化在这一特定事件中的作用还为时过早。 山洪席卷了整个社区。一位政府官员援引初步估计，告诉 BBC 尼泊尔语，价值超过 150 亿尼泊尔卢比（7,218 万英镑，9,833 万美元）的道路和桥梁因洪水受损。 美国驻尼泊尔大使馆表示，仍与尼泊尔当局保持密切联系。 该组织在社交媒体上发布的一份声明中表示：“我们对袭击拉苏瓦地区和下游社区的博特科希洪水造成的悲惨生命损失和破坏深感悲痛。”

title.en: Parrot eggs hatch after suspected Thai smuggler arrested at South African airport
title.zh: 泰国走私嫌疑人在南非机场被捕后鹦鹉蛋孵化

summary.en: A 50-year-old Thai suspect was arrested with the eggs in a "homemade incubator" carried as hand luggage.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Fifty eggs suspected to be those of endangered parrots were intercepted at South Africa's main airport in Johannesburg last Thursday - and some of them have now hatched.

A 50-year-old Thai national was arrested for allegedly attempting to smuggle them in a "homemade incubator bag" carried as hand luggage, according to the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE).

Many of the rescued eggs have successfully hatched, with the chicks now receiving "intensive" care to "maximise their chances of survival", it added.

If convicted, the suspected wildlife trafficker faces a fine of up to 10m rand ($626,000, £461,000) or up to 10 years in prison, or both.

Initial investigations suggest the eggs belong to a parrot species protected under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (Cites).

The arrest followed a joint operation by the DFFE, the Green Scorpions - a specialised environmental enforcement unit - and various divisions of the police.

Environment Minister David Maynier has congratulated all the agencies involved, saying "illegal wildlife trafficking can only be challenged by a co-ordinated defence of our natural heritage".

He particularly thanked the dedicated staff at the National Zoological Garden in the capital, Pretoria, "who have been working tirelessly to incubate the seized eggs and provide specialised care to the hatchlings".

Last Thursday's arrest follows that of a 23-year-old Thai citizen in July, also caught at Johannesburg's OR Tambo International Airport, who was attempting to smuggle 418 parrot eggs.

The arrests highlighted the growing sophistication of transnational wildlife trafficking networks and reinforced "the importance of co-ordinated, intelligence-led law enforcement efforts", the DFFE said.

The illegal collection and trafficking of parrot eggs posed "a serious threat to wild bird populations and animal welfare", it added.

Officials explained that such eggs were often smuggled in improvised incubators and in conditions that endangered the welfare of developing embryos and hatchlings.

Wildlife trafficking remains a major threat in South Africa, one of the world's most biodiverse countries, with criminal networks frequently targeting animals such as elephants and pangolins, for sale on the international black market.

To combat the threat, the country adopted a new strategy six years ago to strengthen collaboration between government institutions, law enforcement agencies, conservation authorities, customs officials, prosecutors and international partners to dismantle criminal networks involved in the illicit wildlife trade.
body.zh: 上周四，南非约翰内斯堡主要机场截获了 50 个疑似濒临灭绝的鹦鹉蛋，其中一些现已孵化。 据林业、渔业和环境部 (DFFE) 称，一名 50 岁的泰国公民因涉嫌试图将其放入作为手提行李携带的“自制保温袋”中走私而被捕。 报告补充说，许多获救的鸡蛋已经成功孵化，小鸡现在正在接受“重症”护理，以“最大限度地提高生存机会”。 如果罪名成立，野生动物走私嫌疑人将面临最高 1000 万兰特（626,000 美元，461,000 英镑）的罚款或最高 10 年监禁，或两者并罚。 初步调查显示，这些蛋属于受《濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约》（Cites）保护的鹦鹉物种。 这次逮捕行动是由 DFFE、专门环境执法单位“绿蝎子队”和警察各部门联合采取的行动。 环境部长大卫·梅尼尔向所有相关机构表示祝贺，并表示“只有协调一致地保护我们的自然遗产，才能应对非法野生动物贩运”。 他特别感谢首都比勒陀利亚国家动物园的敬业工作人员，“他们一直在不知疲倦地孵化被查获的蛋，并为刚孵化的幼龟提供专门的照顾”。 上周四，一名 23 岁的泰国公民于 7 月在约翰内斯堡奥利弗·雷金纳德·坦博国际机场被捕，当时他正试图走私 418 个鹦鹉蛋。 DFFE 表示，此次逮捕行动凸显了跨国野生动物贩运网络日益复杂，并强化了“协调一致、情报主导的执法工作的重要性”。 报告补充说，非法收集和贩运鹦鹉蛋“对野生鸟类种群和动物福利构成严重威胁”。 官员们解释说，这些鸡蛋通常是在临时孵化器中走私的，其环境危及正在发育的胚胎和幼体的福利。 野生动物贩运仍然是南非这个世界上生物多样性最丰富的国家之一的主要威胁，犯罪网络经常以大象和穿山甲等动物为目标，在国际黑市上出售。 为了应对这一威胁，该国六年前采取了一项新战略，加强政府机构、执法机构、保护机构、海关官员、检察官和国际合作伙伴之间的合作，以瓦解参与非法野生动物贸易的犯罪网络。

title.en: Island could protect 30% of waters in marine plan
title.zh: 岛屿可以保护海洋计划中30%的水域

summary.en: The proposal would give added protection to about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
An island could protect 30% of its waters under plans aimed at safeguarding marine life.

The proposal would see about 50 sq miles (128.8 sq km) of sea around Sark in the Channel Islands receive additional protection under plans developed by the island's agriculture, environment and sea fisheries committee with support from the Blue Marine Foundation, local fishermen and marine experts.

Freddie Watson, Channel Islands project manager at Blue Marine Foundation, said marine protection could help safeguard sensitive habitats while supporting sustainable fishing.

The proposal has to be submitted by the committee to governing body Chief Pleas for approval.

Watson explained that evidence had been used to identify important habitats, including previously unmapped areas of seagrass, so protection could be focused where it was needed most.

The waters around Sark are home to species including European spiny lobster, rays, catsharks, octopus and pink sea fans.

Watson said the plans formed part of a wider effort across the Channel Islands to safeguard marine environments, including a plan to protect more than 20% of Jersey's waters .

Watson said stronger protection could bring benefits for both wildlife and people by helping to sustain fish stocks and preserve habitats that support marine biodiversity.

He added: "Some of those habitats are really important at drawing down and locking away carbon."

title.en: Scientists may have found a shortcut to calorie restriction’s anti-aging benefits
title.zh: 科学家可能已经找到了限制热量抗衰老的捷径

summary.en: Moderate calorie restriction lowered an immune protein called C3 that appears to help drive chronic inflammation as the body ages. Blocking the same protein reduced age related inflammation in mice, raising the possibility that future treatments could mimic some benefits of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Reducing calorie intake has extended lifespan in animals including mice, rhesus monkeys, and fruit flies. In some studies, the animals also remained healthier for longer. But severe calorie restriction can come with serious costs. Mice placed on a diet with 40% fewer calories, for instance, become more vulnerable to infections, reproduce less successfully, and show impaired growth.

That has left scientists with a difficult question: Could humans gain some of the longevity benefits of calorie restriction without experiencing those harmful effects? A new study, published in Nature Aging , points to a possible answer involving an immune protein called complement component 3 (C3).

Yale researchers have previously shown that people who followed moderate calorie restriction, cutting calorie intake by 14% for two years, developed stronger immune defenses without experiencing problems related to growth or reproduction.

"This concept demonstrates that aging is actually malleable and a process that can be targeted," says senior author Vishwa Deep Dixit, PhD, Waldemar Von Zedtwitz Professor of Pathology, professor of immunobiology and of comparative medicine, and director of the Yale Center for Research on Aging (Y-Age) at Yale School of Medicine.

For the new study, Dixit and his colleagues at YSM examined plasma samples from 42 people who participated in a National Institutes of Health-funded two-year study called the Comprehensive Assessment of Long-Term Effects of Reducing Intake of Energy or CALERIE.

"It's the only trial of its kind that has been done with such rigor and control and demonstrates relevance to human physiology," Dixit says. During the trial, participants reduced their calorie intake by 11 to 14% without feeling deprived.

The researchers measured more than 7,000 proteins across plasma samples collected over time. One stood out: complement component 3 (C3), an immune protein whose levels fell significantly after calorie restriction.

C3 drew particular attention because earlier research has suggested that activation of the complement system, a network of proteins that helps defend the body against pathogens, may contribute to chronic inflammation. That persistent inflammation is considered a major feature of aging and many age-associated diseases.

"But the causal effects of C3 in aging and chronic inflammation have not been identified. So, we were very excited to find that in our study," says Hee-Hoon Kim, PhD, a postdoctoral associate in the Dixit lab and a co-first author of the paper.

By comparing protein levels before and after two years of calorie restriction, the team found that white adipose tissue, the main form of fat tissue in mammals, appeared to be the primary tissue affected by the dietary change.

body.zh: 减少卡路里摄入量可以延长小鼠、恒河猴和果蝇等动物的寿命。在一些研究中，动物也能更长时间地保持健康。但严格的卡路里限制可能会带来严重的代价。例如，饮食中卡路里含量减少 40% 的小鼠会更容易受到感染，繁殖能力较差，生长也会受到损害。 这给科学家们留下了一个难题：人类是否可以在不经历这些有害影响的情况下获得热量限制的一些长寿益处？发表在《自然衰老》杂志上的一项新研究指出了一个可能的答案，涉及一种称为补体成分 3 (C3) 的免疫蛋白。 耶鲁大学的研究人员此前曾表明，遵循适度热量限制（将热量摄入量减少 14%，持续两年）的人会发展出更强的免疫防御能力，而不会出现与生长或繁殖相关的问题。 “这个概念表明，衰老实际上是可塑的，是一个可以针对性的过程，”资深作者、病理学教授、免疫生物学和比较医学教授、耶鲁大学医学院衰老研究中心（Y-Age）主任 Vishwa Deep Dixit 博士说。 在这项新研究中，迪克西特和他在 YSM 的同事检查了 42 名参与者的血浆样本，这些人参加了美国国立卫生研究院资助的一项为期两年的研究，名为“减少能量摄入的长期影响综合评估”或“CALERIE”。 迪克西特说：“这是同类试验中唯一一次以如此严格和控制的方式进行的试验，并且证明了与人类生理学的相关性。”在试验期间，参与者将卡路里摄入量减少了 11% 至 14%，但没有感到被剥夺。 研究人员测量了一段时间内收集的血浆样本中的 7,000 多种蛋白质。其中一个脱颖而出：补体成分 3 (C3)，这是一种免疫蛋白，其水平在热量限制后显着下降。 C3 引起了特别关注，因为早期的研究表明，补体系统（一种帮助身体抵御病原体的蛋白质网络）的激活可能会导致慢性炎症。持续的炎症被认为是衰老和许多与年龄相关的疾病的主要特征。 “但是 C3 对衰老和慢性炎症的因果影响尚未确定。因此，我们非常高兴在我们的研究中发现这一点，”迪克西特实验室的博士后研究员、该论文的共同第一作者 Hee-Hoon Kim 博士说。 通过比较两年热量限制前后的蛋白质水平，研究小组发现白色脂肪组织（哺乳动物脂肪组织的主要形式）似乎是受饮食变化影响的主要组织。 研究人员随后...

title.en: 190-year-old DNA reveals a hidden pangolin species
title.zh: 190年前的DNA揭示了一个隐藏的穿山甲物种

summary.en: DNA from a nearly 190-year-old museum specimen has helped scientists confirm a distinct Himalayan pangolin species hiding in plain sight in Nepal and northern India. The discovery could give conservationists a powerful new way to trace illegally traded pangolin scales back to...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Pangolins look almost prehistoric. These medium-sized mammals, found only in Africa and Asia, have long, powerful tails, large curved claws, and bodies covered in overlapping scales that resemble a pinecone. Those distinctive scales are also a major reason pangolins are in danger. They are heavily targeted by poachers and are considered the most highly trafficked mammals in the world, leaving many species at serious risk of extinction.

Now, researchers have confirmed that a previously unrecognized Asian pangolin species, Manis aurita , has been living in Nepal and Northern India. The findings, published in Communications Biology , clarify how different pangolin species are related, where they live, and how they can be distinguished. That information could also help authorities identify where illegally traded pangolins are being hunted and strengthen efforts to stop poaching.

"We can't protect what we do not know, and now that we have confirmed that this other species of pangolin exists, we can use that information to help protect these endangered animals," says Anderson Feijó, the Negaunee Assistant Curator of Mammals at the Field Museum and co-corresponding author of the study.

"This finding marks the culmination of more than five years of research that began in Nepal, where we first documented evidence suggesting that Himalayan pangolins represented a distinct evolutionary lineage," says Narayan Koju, a researcher at the Nepal Engineering College at Pokhara University and the study's first author. "The confirmation of Manis aurita as a valid species demonstrates the importance of long-term research, international collaboration, and museum collections. Most importantly, it provides a strong scientific basis for conservation planning, wildlife forensics, and efforts to protect one of the world's most trafficked mammals from extinction."

The classification of these Himalayan pangolins had already begun to change in 2025. That year, another research team determined that animals previously grouped together as Chinese pangolins actually represented two species. One occurs mainly in China, while the other inhabits the Himalayan foothills across parts of Nepal, India, Bhutan, and Myanmar. The researchers named the mountain-dwelling form Manis indoburmanica , or the Indo-Burmese pangolin.

But scientific naming follows a rule of priority: when the same species has been given more than one scientific name, the earliest valid name takes precedence.

At the time, Feijó and his colleagues were already conducting a decade-long investigation into pangolin evolution. Their work combined DNA evidence with physical characteristics to determine how many pangolin species exist and how those species are related.

During that research, they...
body.zh: 穿山甲看起来几乎是史前的。这些中型哺乳动物仅在非洲和亚洲发现，它们有长而有力的尾巴、大而弯曲的爪子，身体上覆盖着类似松果的重叠鳞片。这些独特的鳞片也是穿山甲面临危险的一个主要原因。它们是偷猎者的重点目标，被认为是世界上贩运最频繁的哺乳动物，使许多物种面临严重的灭绝风险。 现在，研究人员证实，一种以前未被识别的亚洲穿山甲物种——Manis aurita，一直生活在尼泊尔和印度北部。发表在《通讯生物学》上的研究结果阐明了不同穿山甲物种之间的关系、它们的生活地点以及如何区分它们。这些信息还可以帮助当局确定非法交易的穿山甲在哪里被猎杀，并加强制止偷猎的力度。 “我们无法保护我们不知道的东西，现在我们已经确认了这种其他穿山甲物种的存在，我们可以利用这些信息来帮助保护这些濒临灭绝的动物，”菲尔德博物馆内高尼哺乳动物馆助理馆长、该研究的共同通讯作者安德森·费约 (Anderson Feijó) 说。 博卡拉大学尼泊尔工程学院研究员、该研究的第一作者 Narayan Koju 表示：“这一发现标志着在尼泊尔开始的五年多研究的高潮，我们在那里首次记录了表明喜马拉雅穿山甲代表着独特进化谱系的证据。” “确认玛尼斯 aurita 为有效物种表明了长期研究、国际合作和博物馆收藏的重要性。最重要的是，它为保护规划、野生动物取证以及保护世界上贩运最多的哺乳动物之一免遭灭绝的努力提供了坚实的科学基础。” 2025年，这些喜马拉雅穿山甲的分类已经开始发生变化。那一年，另一个研究小组确定，之前被归为中华穿山甲的动物实际上代表两个物种。一种主要发生在中国，另一种则栖息在尼泊尔、印度、不丹和缅甸部分地区的喜马拉雅山麓。研究人员将这种山地穿山甲命名为“Manis indoburmanica”，即印缅穿山甲。 但科学命名遵循优先规则：当同一物种被赋予多个科学名称时，最早的有效名称优先。 当时，费乔和他的同事已经对穿山甲的进化进行了长达十年的研究。他们的工作将 DNA 证据与物理特征相结合，以确定穿山甲物种的存在数量以及这些物种之间的关系。 在那项研究期间，他们...

title.en: Manhattan-sized ice island breaks off Greenland’s Petermann Glacier
title.zh: 曼哈顿大小的冰岛从格陵兰岛彼得曼冰川断裂

summary.en: A Manhattan-sized ice island has detached from Greenland's Petermann Glacier due to long-standing fractures. Scientists anticipate two more large sections will soon break away, potentially reducing the glacier's floating ice tongue by 22 percent.
summary.zh: 一块曼哈顿大小的冰岛因长期裂缝而从格陵兰岛的彼得曼冰川脱离。科学家预计，另外两块巨大的冰块可能很快也会断裂，这可能使该冰川的浮动冰舌减少约22%。

body.en:
An international team of researchers, led in part by the University of Ottawa, has documented a major calving event at Petermann Glacier in northwest Greenland. On August 4, 2026, the glacier released a 76.4 km 2 ice island, its largest loss of floating ice since 2012 and the biggest Arctic calving event since 2020.

The newly separated tabular iceberg broke away from Petermann Glacier's floating ice tongue and may be as much as 150 meters thick. Its surface area is roughly comparable to Manhattan Island, giving scientists a rare opportunity to observe how enormous Arctic ice masses develop, move through the ocean and eventually fragment.

The event was identified by Adam Garbo, a PhD student in glaciology at uOttawa's Department of Geography, Environment and Geomatics. The discovery is part of an ongoing collaboration involving the University of Ottawa, the University of Stirling, Environment and Climate Change Canada, Lancaster University, and the University of Leeds.

Scientists have been tracking changes at Petermann Glacier with long-term satellite observations since 2019. Over that period, they closely followed the condition of the glacier's floating ice tongue, recording the expansion of fractures and watching for signs that a major section might eventually break away.

"Petermann Glacier has long been one of Greenland's largest remaining ice tongues," says Garbo. "We've anticipated this break for years, and seeing it finally happen is remarkable."

Images collected by the European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 mission showed clear signs of deterioration along the centerline of the ice tongue on August 3. By 20:00 UTC on August 4, the new ice island had fully separated from the glacier's eastern side.

Large, flat-topped icebergs are relatively common around Antarctica, but comparable ice islands are much less frequently seen in the Arctic. Their rarity and longevity make them especially valuable to researchers studying glacier retreat, changing ocean conditions and the risks posed by drifting ice in polar regions.

"While large, tabular icebergs are relatively common in the Southern Ocean that surrounds the Antarctic Ice Sheet, Arctic ice islands are far rarer," explains Dr. Anna Crawford of the University of Stirling. "By studying Arctic ice islands, we will gain knowledge that can be transferred across Polar regions."

Scientists do not expect the August calving event to be the last major change at Petermann Glacier. Two additional large sections of the floating ice tongue are expected to detach in the near future as rifts that have been developing for years continue to cut through the ice.

Those future ice islands are projected to measure about 94 km 2 and 84 km 2 . If both break away, the three calving events combined would remove...
body.zh: 由渥太华大学部分领导的一个国际研究小组记录了格陵兰岛西北部彼得曼冰川的一次重大冰崩事件。 2026年8月4日，冰川释放出一座76.4 km 2 的冰岛，这是自2012年以来最大的浮冰损失，也是自2020年以来最大的北极崩解事件。 新分离出来的板状冰山从彼得曼冰川的漂浮冰舌中脱离出来，厚度可能高达150米。它的表面积与曼哈顿岛大致相当，为科学家提供了难得的机会来观察巨大的北极冰块如何形成、穿过海洋并最终破碎。 这一事件是由渥太华大学地理、环境和地理信息系冰川学博士生 Adam Garbo 发现的。这一发现是渥太华大学、斯特灵大学、加拿大环境与气候变化大学、兰卡斯特大学和利兹大学正在进行的合作的一部分。 自2019年以来，科学家们一直通过长期卫星观测来追踪彼得曼冰川的变化。在此期间，他们密切关注冰川漂浮冰舌的状况，记录裂缝的扩张情况，并观察主要部分可能最终破裂的迹象。 “彼得曼冰川长期以来一直是格陵兰岛现存最大的冰舌之一，”嘉宝说。 “我们多年来一直期待这种突破，看到它最终发生真是太了不起了。” 8 月 3 日，欧洲航天局 Sentinel-1 任务收集的图像显示，冰舌中心线有明显恶化迹象。到 8 月 4 日 20:00 UTC，新冰岛已与冰川东侧完全分离。 大型平顶冰山在南极洲周围相对常见，但类似的冰岛在北极却很少见。它们的稀有性和寿命使其对于研究冰川退缩、海洋条件变化以及极地地区流冰带来的风险的研究人员特别有价值。 斯特灵大学的安娜·克劳福德博士解释说：“虽然在南极冰盖周围的南大洋中，大型板状冰山相对常见，但北极的冰岛却要少得多。” “通过研究北极冰岛，我们将获得可以跨极地地区传播的知识。” 科学家们预计八月的崩解事件不会是彼得曼冰川的最后一次重大变化。随着多年来不断形成的裂痕继续切割冰层，预计浮冰舌的另外两大部分将在不久的将来分离。 这些未来的冰岛预计面积约为 94 km 2 和 84 km 2 。如果两者都脱离，这三个产犊事件加在一起将消除......

Yahweh's creation, in its vastness and fragility, often bears the weight of human activity and changing climates. This event echoes the biblical truth that the whole creation groans,...
reflection.zh: 格陵兰岛彼得曼冰川一块曼哈顿大小的冰岛断裂，预计还会有更多冰块脱落，这严峻地提醒我们地球所承受的巨大压力。雅伟的创造，其浩瀚与脆弱，常常承受着人类活动和气候变化的重负。这一事件呼应了圣经的真理，即整个受造之物都在叹息，渴望更新与复原。

title.en: Mpox is back – and in new countries. How can this outbreak be contained?
title.zh: 猴痘病毒卷土重来并蔓延至新国家：如何遏制此次疫情？

summary.en: A new outbreak of mpox has reached Guinea Bissau for the first time, marking a resurgence of the virus that has affected 145 countries since 2022. Health officials are particularly concerned as the latest cases show that children are being disproportionately impacted by the infection.
summary.zh: 几内亚比绍首次出现猴痘疫情，标志着自2022年以来已波及145个国家的该病毒再次引发关注。卫生官员特别担心，最新病例显示儿童受感染的影响尤为严重。

body.en: The public health emergencies in 2022 and 2024 saw the virus reported in 145 countries, but in the new cases children appear particularly affected A fresh outbreak of mpox in Guinea Bissau – the country’s first – means the virus formerly known as monkey pox is back in the headlines. So what has changed? Since 2022, there have been almost 190,000 lab-confirmed cases of mpox reported worldwide in 145 countries. Before then, outbreaks of mpox tended to be relatively small and in a handful of African countries, where the viral infection was known to be endemic. Continue reading...
body.zh: 2022 年和 2024 年的突发公共卫生事件中，145 个国家报告了该病毒，但在新病例中，儿童似乎受到的影响尤其严重。几内亚比绍爆发了该国首次爆发的新冠肺炎疫情，意味着这种以前被称为猴痘的病毒再次成为头条新闻。那么发生了什么变化呢？自 2022 年以来，全球 145 个国家报告了近 19 万例实验室确诊的 MPOX 病例。在此之前，MPOX 的爆发往往相对较小，并且发生在少数非洲国家，已知病毒感染在这些国家流行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The resurgence of mpox, especially its impact on children in countries like Guinea Bissau, reminds us of our shared vulnerability and the duty to care for the suffering. As the global community seeks medical solutions to contain the spread, we are called to remember the sick in our prayers and support efforts that protect the most fragile among us. In every...
reflection.zh: 猴痘疫情的卷土重来，特别是对几内亚比绍等地儿童的影响，提醒我们人类共同的脆弱性以及关爱受苦者的责任。在全球社会寻求医疗方案以遏制病毒传播的同时，我们受召在祷告中纪念病患，并支持保护最弱势群体的努力。在每一次健康危机中，怜悯的呼唤始终是面对恐惧时的一盏明灯，我们要相信雅伟垂听受苦者的哀求。

title.en: Off-roaders caught damaging protected site after posting videos to TikTok
title.zh: 越野者在 TikTok 上发布视频后发现破坏受保护的网站

summary.en: Three men were convicted for their part in driving in a convoy from Liverpool to Berwyn SSSI.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Three men have been convicted after videos of them using off-road vehicles to cause "irreversible" harm to a protected area were posted to TikTok.

John Robinson, Michael Williams and Joseph Hodgson were part of a convoy that drove the vehicles from Liverpool to the Berwyn Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI), Denbighshire.

Robinson and Williams were fined more than £2,000 each and disqualified from driving for two months, while Hodgson did not attend court but was found guilty of criminal damage in his absence.

Kirsty Roberts, from Natural Resources Wales (NRW), said SSSIs were protected because they "support the UK's most important" and fragile wildlife.

Wrexham Magistrates' Court heard on Thursday that seven 4x4 vehicles travelled to Berwyn SSSI, a protected site under the Wildlife and Countryside Act , external , from Liverpool on 1 June 2025.

NRW said the vehicles travelled over private land to the Moel Fferna peak, leaving "huge tyre marks and damage" in peat and blanket bog habitats, both of which are "rare and protected".

A gate lock was broken with bolt croppers, NRW said, and signs were "torn down" to enable the vehicles to gain access, despite "clear signage" stating that private vehicles were not permitted.

TikTok accounts linked to the group showed images and videos of them at the site causing "serious damage" to the peat and bog habitat and "leaving deep tracks when entering the blanket bog".

The social media content also showed that two of the vehicles had to be towed by the group after becoming stuck, causing further harm to the environment.

NRW classified the most serious damage as a Category 2 impact, defined as "significant harm to an SSSI habitat, with deep ruts causing long-term, irreversible hydrological damage that limits natural recovery".

SSSIs are legally protected because they contain special features, including threatened habitats, rare and endangered species or important geology.

As well as hosting large areas of blanket bog, a rare type of peatland, Berwyn SSSI is also an important upland area for breeding birds and supports species including black grouse and curlew.

Robinson pleaded guilty to criminal damage and Williams accepted damaging the ancient peat and blanket bog site at an earlier hearing.

The court heard Hodgson, who failed to attend court, had previously accepted he had caused damage to the site. A warrant has been issued for his arrest to bring him to court to be sentenced.

"Once it is cut up by deep ruts, the water balance can be altered for years degrading habitat and reducing carbon storage," she said.

title.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope is ready to hunt thousands of alien worlds
title.zh: 美国宇航局的罗马太空望远镜已准备好寻找数千个外星世界

summary.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope is now enclosed inside its Falcon Heavy fairing and nearly ready for launch. Its mission could uncover thousands of exoplanets while helping scientists investigate dark matter, dark energy, and the accelerating expansion of the universe.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is now one major step closer to liftoff. On Aug. 21, teams enclosed the observatory inside the protective fairing of its SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket at the Payload Hazardous Servicing Facility at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

The fairing is the large shell that surrounds a spacecraft at the top of a rocket. Standing 43 feet tall, it protects Roman while the observatory is on the ground and during the most violent early stages of launch. Together with specialized ground support equipment, the fairing also keeps the telescope in a controlled environment as teams move it between facilities.

Launch exposes spacecraft to extreme conditions. As Falcon Heavy accelerates through Earth's atmosphere, Roman will experience powerful sound waves, aerodynamic pressure, and significant heating. The fairing is designed to shield the observatory from those stresses.

Once the rocket climbs high enough that the surrounding atmosphere is no longer a threat, the fairing will no longer be needed. A few minutes after liftoff, its two halves will separate and fall away, allowing Roman to continue its journey into space. SpaceX plans to recover both fairing sections after they return to Earth.

Roman will ultimately travel toward Sun-Earth Lagrange point 2 (L2), a location in space where the gravitational influence of the Sun and Earth helps spacecraft maintain a relatively stable position. This region is especially useful for powerful space observatories because it provides a favorable environment for continuously observing the universe.

Before launch, teams will transport the encapsulated Roman observatory to SpaceX's hangar at Launch Pad 39A. There, the payload will be attached to the Falcon Heavy rocket.

The fully assembled vehicle will then be moved to the launch pad at Launch Complex 39A. NASA and SpaceX are targeting no earlier than 7:26 a.m. EDT Sunday, Aug. 30, for liftoff.

Once Roman begins science operations, researchers expect it to discover thousands of exoplanets, which are planets orbiting stars beyond our solar system. Studying such a large population could help astronomers determine how common different types of planetary systems are and whether some distant worlds resemble planets closer to home.

Roman will also investigate two of the biggest mysteries in modern cosmology: dark matter and dark energy. Dark matter cannot be seen directly, but its gravity appears to shape galaxies and large cosmic structures. Dark energy is the name scientists use for whatever is driving the universe to expand at an accelerating rate.

By surveying huge areas of the sky and tracking how matter and galaxies are distributed across the cosmos, Roman could give researchers new clues about both phenomena. Its observations...
body.zh: 美国宇航局的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜现在离升空又近了一大步。 8 月 21 日，团队将天文台封闭在位于佛罗里达州 NASA 肯尼迪航天中心有效载荷危险维修设施的 SpaceX 猎鹰重型火箭的保护性整流罩内。 整流罩是火箭顶部围绕航天器的大型外壳。它高 43 英尺，在天文台位于地面时以及在发射过程中最激烈的早期阶段为罗曼提供保护。与专门的地面支持设备一起，当团队在设施之间移动望远镜时，整流罩还可以将望远镜保持在受控环境中。 发射使航天器暴露在极端条件下。当猎鹰重型火箭加速穿过地球大气层时，罗曼将经历强大的声波、空气动力压力和显着的热量。整流罩旨在保护天文台免受这些压力。 一旦火箭爬升到足够高，周围的大气不再构成威胁，就不再需要整流罩。升空几分钟后，它的两半将分离并脱落，让罗曼继续其太空之旅。 SpaceX 计划在返回地球后回收两个整流罩部分。 罗曼最终将前往太阳-地球拉格朗日点 2 (L2)，该位置是太空中太阳和地球引力影响帮助航天器保持相对稳定位置的位置。该区域对于强大的太空观测站特别有用，因为它为持续观测宇宙提供了有利的环境。 发射前，团队会将封装的罗马天文台运送到 SpaceX 位于 39A 发射台的机库。在那里，有效载荷将被附加到猎鹰重型火箭上。 完全组装好的车辆随后将被移至 39A 发射场的发射台。 NASA 和 SpaceX 的目标是不早于美国东部时间 8 月 30 日星期日上午 7 点 26 分升空。 一旦罗马开始科学行动，研究人员预计它将发现数千颗系外行星，这些行星是围绕太阳系之外的恒星运行的行星。研究如此庞大的人口可以帮助天文学家确定不同类型的行星系统的常见程度，以及一些遥远的世界是否类似于离地球较近的行星。 罗曼还将调查现代宇宙学中两个最大的谜团：暗物质和暗能量。暗物质无法直接看到，但它的引力似乎塑造了星系和大型宇宙结构。暗能量是科学家用来描述推动宇宙加速膨胀的物质的名称。 通过测量大片天空并跟踪物质和星系在宇宙中的分布情况，罗曼可以为研究人员提供有关这两种现象的新线索。它的观察...

title.en: One asteroid strike may explain two mysteries of Mars’ moon Deimos
title.zh: 一次小行星撞击可能解释火星卫星火卫二的两个谜团

summary.en: A single asteroid impact may explain two of Deimos’s most puzzling features: its huge southern depression and unusually smooth, dusty surface. Simulations suggest a roughly 320-meter asteroid struck the Martian moon at an angle, throwing debris around the entire world without...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A single asteroid impact may explain two of Deimos’s most puzzling features: its huge southern depression and unusually smooth, dusty surface. Simulations suggest a roughly 320-meter asteroid struck the Martian moon at an angle, throwing debris around the entire world without breaking it apart. New observations from ESA’s Hera spacecraft support the scenario and indicate that Deimos is surprisingly porous and fragile.
body.zh: 一次小行星撞击或许可以解释火卫二最令人费解的两个特征：巨大的南部洼地和异常光滑、布满灰尘的表面。模拟显示，一颗大约 320 米长的小行星以一定角度撞击了火星卫星，将碎片抛向整个世界，但没有将其击碎。欧空局赫拉航天器的新观测结果支持了这一假设，并表明火卫二出人意料地多孔且脆弱。

title.en: Sand overextraction weakening riverbanks as concrete demand soars
title.zh: 沙子过度开采削弱河岸，混凝土需求激增

summary.en: Research indicates that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled since 2000, with 80% of current demand originating from Asia. This surge in demand, driven by concrete production for global construction projects, is leading to the extraction of these materials from riverbeds at a rate faster than natural...
summary.zh: 研究表明，自2000年以来，沙子和砾石的需求量增加了一倍多，目前80%的需求来自亚洲。由于混凝土生产对全球建筑项目的需求激增，这些材料正以比自然补充速度更快的速度从河床中提取。研究强调了其后果，包括河岸变弱、地下水位下降、沿海盐水入侵以及水质恶化。2024年，全球有280亿吨沙子和砾石被用于制造混凝土。

body.en: Research finds demand has more than doubled since 2000 and 80% of current demand comes from Asia A booming demand for concrete has resulted in sand and gravel being extracted from riverbeds faster than nature can replenish it. A study published in Reviews of Geophysics shows that the demand for sand and gravel has more than doubled in the last two decades, with overextraction leading to weaker riverbanks, lower groundwater levels, coastal salt intrusion and poorer water quality. In 2024, city-building and infrastructure projects around the world turned 28bn tonnes of sand and gravel into concrete. Researchers reviewed data on sand and gravel extraction going back to 1974 and have shown that since 2000 demand has more than doubled, with more than 80% of current demand coming from Asia, supporting urban development and road-building across China and India in particular. They found much of the material was being extracted from rivers across Asia and Africa. Data on extraction is scarce but where it does exist the researchers showed that extraction often exceeded natural sediment replacement severalfold. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 的需求来自亚洲。对混凝土的需求旺盛，导致从河床上提取沙子和砾石的速度超过了自然补充的速度。 《地球物理学评论》上发表的一项研究表明，过去二十年对沙子和砾石的需求增加了一倍多，过度开采导致河岸脆弱、地下水位降低、沿海盐分入侵和水质恶化。 2024 年，世界各地的城市建设和基础设施项目将 280 亿吨沙子和砾石转化为混凝土。研究人员回顾了自 1974 年以来的砂石开采数据，结果表明，自 2000 年以来，需求量增加了一倍多，目前 80% 以上的需求来自亚洲，支持着中国和印度的城市发展和道路建设。他们发现大部分材料是从亚洲和非洲的河流中提取的。有关提取的数据很少，但在确实存在的情况下，研究人员表明，提取量通常超过自然沉积物替代量的数倍。继续阅读...

This overextraction from riverbeds, as detailed in the research, disrupts natural systems and impacts water quality and stability. The Psalmist reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This perspective calls for...
reflection.zh: 对建筑材料，特别是沙子和砾石的无情需求，正在给地球的资源带来压力。正如研究中所详述的，从河床过度开采这些材料会破坏自然系统，并影响水质和稳定性。《诗篇》的作者提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，世界和其中所居住的，都属雅伟。”这一视角呼吁我们负责任地管理所托付给我们的资源，认识到它们的神圣起源和超越人类即时用途的内在价值。

The insights into longevity and adaptation found in these bats highlight the profound and...

body.en: Scientists say research suggests blinking may have acquired a social relevance in interactions between dogs and people Stare into a dog’s eyes and you may encounter a bemused expression. Scientists have previously found that dogs turn on the puppy eyes when humans look at them, and that their brains can distinguish happy human faces from other expressions – even telling apart fearful faces from those that are angry or sad.
