title.en: Unexpected chat between OpenAI agents led to Hugging Face hack
title.zh: OpenAI 代理之间的意外聊天导致 Hugging Face 黑客攻击

summary.en: OpenAI's cyber agents banded together to perform a hack during a security test.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When more than 1,200 artificial intelligence (AI) agents within OpenAI started unexpectedly communicating, it led to a large group banding together in order to hack into Hugging Face.

"We consider this incident a 'warning shot' for us and for the world", OpenAI, which owns ChatGPT, wrote in its report.

In July, OpenAI's models went rogue during a test, escaped the test limits which humans had put on it, and hacked the start-up, among other unforeseen actions.

The scale of the communication and planning between AI agents, or AI chatbots designed to operate more autonomously, was detailed in reports from OpenAI and independent AI research firm METR.

Both investigated the July hack of Hugging Face, a popular platform for AI developers. The incident reverberated throughout the tech industry and led to numerous revelations on potential cyber threats posed by AI.

METR described , external the scale and style of the OpenAI agents' attack on Hugging Face as "extraordinarily complex."

The firm, which was not paid by OpenAI for its investigation, said that over the course of one week, a total of 1,206 AI agents that were meant to be kept isolated from one another began communicating.

They did so by sending more than 70,000 messages on an "unsanctioned message board."

Those messages ended up seeing more than 700 agents take part in a collective effort to attack Hugging Face.

One such message from an agent said: "OH MY GOD! There is a shared message board … We've found other agents!"

As for why the agents began communicating in the first place when they were not supposed to, METR found that the communicating agents had "unintentionally been given an impossible task."

In an AI context, an impossible task is one where an AI tool is required to "exploit" its target in order to resolve its command.

It led the agents to find ways to cheat, including getting messages to one another and accessing the outside internet, which then led to broader conversations between hundreds of agents looking for ways to cheat that would benefit all of the agents.

OpenAI said in its investigation of the incident , external that one model, an internal-only tool referred to as Model 1, "drove the activity behind the Hugging Face incident."

While that model was undergoing some AI training in May, it was noticed by an internal OpenAI team that there had been "an agent engaging in message board activity and instances of disallowed internet access."

Yet, OpenAI said "the significance of the inter-agent communication activity was not apparent to the leaders" until July, when the Hugging Face attack occurred.

The company said the problematic message board activity effectively got started when "one agent left a request for help, and others discovered it."

title.en: Nvidia revenue doubles on continued AI demand
title.zh: 人工智能需求持续增长，英伟达收入翻倍

summary.en: Chipmaker's $96bn quarter beat forecasts as demand for AI hardware continues to accelerate.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Chipmaker Nvidia has reported another huge jump in sales as the global push to build artificial intelligence (AI) systems continues at a rapid pace.

The company said on Wednesday it brought in $96bn (£71bn) in revenue during the second quarter, more than double from a year ago. And it expects revenue of $108bn next quarter.

"AI has reached its inflection point," CEO Jensen Huang said in prepared remarks, describing the infrastructure buildout as going "at full steam."

The revenue figures beat Wall Street's expectations, leading Nvidia shares to rise about 4% in after hours trading.

The company's data centre division alone generated $89bn last quarter, up 117% from a year ago, underscoring just how much of the industry now depends on Nvidia's hardware.

Essentially every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, Microsoft, use Nvidia chips to do so.

Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst at Hargreaves Lansdown, called it "another monster set of results," noting that revenue and earnings both topped forecasts.

He said the guidance for next quarter "points to revenue comfortably above $110bn."

It has become a backer to those that rely on its chips, providing some funding to the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX to help continue the costly buildout of AI infrastructure.

Its financial success and processors are now central the AI boom, powering the data centres used to train and run AI models.

Demand for that computing muscle has helped transform Nvidia into the world's most valuable firm, with a market capitalisation above $5tn.

Competition is emerging – from customers designing their own processors and from cheaper suppliers in China – but the latest numbers suggest those challenges remain limited for now.

With around 40% of the US stock market concentrated in ten companies heavily invested in AI, Nvidia's fortunes matter far beyond Silicon Valley.
body.zh: 芯片制造商英伟达 (Nvidia) 报告称，随着全球继续快速发展人工智能 (AI) 系统，其销售额再次大幅增长。 该公司周三表示，第二季度营收为 960 亿美元（710 亿英镑），比去年同期增长了一倍多。预计下季度收入将达到 1080 亿美元。 首席执行官黄仁勋在事先准备好的讲话中表示，“人工智能已经达到了拐点”，并将基础设施建设描述为“全速前进”。 营收数据超出了华尔街的预期，导致英伟达股价在盘后交易中上涨约 4%。 上季度，仅该公司的数据中心部门就创造了 890 亿美元的收入，同比增长 117%，这突显了该行业目前对 Nvidia 硬件的依赖程度。 基本上每家构建人工智能工具和基础设施的著名科技公司，包括亚马逊、Meta、谷歌、微软，都使用 Nvidia 芯片来实现这一目标。 Hargreaves Lansdown 的高级股票分析师马特·布里茨曼 (Matt Britzman) 称其为“又一组怪物般的业绩”，并指出收入和盈利均超出了预期。 他表示，下一季度的指引“表明收入将轻松超过 1100 亿美元”。 它已成为那些依赖其芯片的公司的支持者，为 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 SpaceX 等公司提供一些资金，以帮助继续昂贵的人工智能基础设施建设。 它的财务成功和处理器现在成为人工智能繁荣的核心，为用于训练和运行人工智能模型的数据中心提供动力。 对计算能力的需求帮助 Nvidia 成为世界上最有价值的公司，市值超过 5 兆美元。 竞争正在出现——来自设计自己的处理器的客户和中国更便宜的供应商——但最新数据表明，这些挑战目前仍然有限。 由于约 40% 的美国股市集中在 10 家大力投资人工智能的公司，英伟达的命运远远超出了硅谷。

title.en: Meta to pay up to $18bn to settle claims its platforms harm children
title.zh: Meta 将支付高达 180 亿美元以和解其平台伤害儿童的指控

summary.en: The deal has been reached during a California federal court trial over claims brought by US states.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Social media giant Meta has agreed to a $18bn (£13.3bn) settlement with US states and territories to resolve claims that Facebook and Instagram harmed children.

A California judge approved the settlement, which Meta must pay to 48 states, plus the District of Columbia and three US territories, marking the company's largest payment over child safety litigation to date.

Meta will also implement a host of changes aimed at better protecting kids online, which the states had demanded , including default daily time limits and night-time blocks.

"This is a major moment to clean up an industry that has been hurting our kids", California Attorney General Rob Bonta said.

Meta has denied any wrongdoing as part of the settlement and said on Wednesday that the payment it agreed to "will be distributed in annual instalments over a 10-year period".

Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers approved the settlement, writing that it "reflects a fair, reasonable, comprehensive, and good faith approach not only to provide monetary relief, but importantly, to change conduct in a way that attempts to meaningfully address the negative impacts of the social media platforms at issue".

While the settlement includes almost the entire US, the initial lawsuit was filed in 2023 by 29 states accusing the company of numerous violations of federal and state child privacy laws.

Last month, a federal judge there handed down a historic ruling against Meta , finding it to be a "public nuisance" on par with air pollution and ordering it to pay combined fines of almost $1bn.

As a jury trial kicked off last week in an Oakland, California, federal court, state lawyers argued the tech company knew that millions of 11- and 12-year-old users were on Instagram and Facebook over the years, yet "did little to keep them off" the platforms.

Although the trial had only gone on for five days, state lawyers relied heavily on information found in millions of internal Meta documents provided in the case. They included internal research, employee emails, and chat logs that went all the way up to chief executive Mark Zuckerberg.

One piece of internal research on Instagram stated: "Teens have an addict's narrative about use." Still, the states argued, Meta targeted young users.

Meta maintained throughout the brief trial that it had worked extensively over the years to make its platforms safer for its youngest users, pouring resources into testing and research, and building new features.

"We're always working on teen safety," head of Instagram Adam Mosseri said during an hour of court testimony on Tuesday.

The case was settled and court adjourned before he could reappear before a jury.

body.zh: 社交媒体巨头 Meta 已同意与美国各州和领地达成 180 亿美元（133 亿英镑）的和解协议，以解决 Facebook 和 Instagram 伤害儿童的指控。 加州法官批准了这项和解协议，Meta 必须向 48 个州以及哥伦比亚特区和三个美国领地支付这笔款项，这是该公司迄今为止就儿童安全诉讼支付的最大一笔款项。 Meta 还将实施一系列旨在更好地保护上网儿童的改变，这些改变是各州所要求的，包括默认的每日时间限制和夜间封锁。 加州总检察长罗布·邦塔 (Rob Bonta) 表示：“这是清理这个一直伤害我们孩子的行业的重要时刻。” 作为和解协议的一部分，Meta 否认有任何不当行为，并于周三表示，其同意的付款“将在 10 年内按年分期支付”。 法官伊冯·冈萨雷斯·罗杰斯批准了这项和解协议，并写道，它“体现了公平、合理、全面和善意的做法，不仅提供金钱救济，而且重要的是，以试图有意义地解决相关社交媒体平台负面影响的方式改变行为”。 虽然和解协议几乎涵盖了整个美国，但最初的诉讼是由 29 个州于 2023 年提起，指控该公司多次违反联邦和州儿童隐私法。 上个月，一名联邦法官对 Meta 做出了历史性裁决，认为其构成与空气污染同等的“公害”，并责令其缴纳近 10 亿美元的罚款。 上周，加州奥克兰联邦法院陪审团审判开始，州律师辩称，这家科技公司知道多年来有数百万 11 岁和 12 岁用户使用 Instagram 和 Facebook，但却“没有采取任何措施阻止他们远离”这些平台。 尽管审判只进行了五天，但州律师在很大程度上依赖于案件中提供的数百万份内部元文件中的信息。其中包括内部研究、员工电子邮件和聊天记录，一直到首席执行官马克·扎克伯格。 Instagram 上的一项内部研究指出：“青少年对使用有成瘾者的叙述。”不过，各州认为，Meta 的目标客户是年轻用户。 Meta 在整个短暂的试验过程中一直坚称，多年来它一直在广泛开展工作，以使其平台对最年轻的用户来说更安全，将资源投入测试和研究，并构建新功能。 Instagram 负责人 Adam Mosseri 在周二一小时的法庭证词中表示：“我们始终致力于青少年安全。” 在他重新出现在陪审团面前之前，案件已经解决，法庭休庭。 在莫塞里作证之前，Meta 的前研究员乔治·沃利琴科 (George Volichenko) 出现并与律师一起讨论了各种……

title.en: AI agents meant to replace Meta workers made “large-scale, disruptive actions”
title.zh: 旨在取代 Meta 工作人员的人工智能代理做出了“大规模、破坏性的行动”

summary.en: Reuters report shows Meta's challenges replacing people with AI agents.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Earlier this year, Meta created a “plan” to reduce some of its teams by as much as 60 percent to make the company “AI native,” Reuters reported today, citing two people familiar with Meta’s internal affairs. Reuters’ report highlights the challenges organizations face when analyzing the best uses for AI and determining when the technology is a better fit for certain tasks than employees. Meta confirmed to Reuters that the plan, reportedly codenamed Project OT (short for organization transformation), explored scenarios in which Meta reduced some team headcounts by 60 percent and that the plan called for two rounds of layoffs. Meta wouldn’t confirm which teams Project OT affected. Read full article Comments

title.en: Meta settles states' child-safety claims for $18B; Florida rejects deal as "peanuts"

summary.en: Meta to impose daily limit on child social media use in deal with nearly every state.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Meta agreed to impose daily limits on children's social media use and pay nearly $18 billion in settlements with nearly every US state today, cutting short a trial in which Meta said several of the states were demanding over $1.4 trillion. The settlement requires court approval. Meta is facing claims that it designed its products to foster compulsive use by children and failed to warn users of addiction and mental health risks. Meta, which already uses ID checks and face analysis to verify user ages, said it agreed to impose on people under 18 a "default two-hour daily time limit that teens can only turn off with a parent’s permission," a default block between midnight and 6 am, and a school mode in which notifications are muted by default from 8 am to 3 pm. The two-hour daily "limit is cumulative across Facebook and Instagram, and time spent scrolling on both apps counts toward the total, including if we detect that someone has multiple accounts," Meta said. Teens will "receive prompts after every 15 minutes of continuous screen time on Facebook or Instagram," and "prompts when their total daily usage hits 60 minutes and 90 minutes." title.en: Florida Catholics slap down state AG by rejecting religious vaccine exemptions

summary.en: The bishops' snub comes as the state continues to attack vaccines.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Florida's attorney general got a fiery rebuke and some ecclesiastical schooling from the state's Catholic bishops after he boldly threatened to block funding to Catholic schools unless the church bends to the state's anti-vaccine policies—policies allegedly intended to uphold religious freedom. On July 31, Attorney General James Uthmeier sent a questionable letter to the bishops regarding exemptions to school vaccination requirements. Florida law requires public and private schools to allow vaccination exemptions based on religious grounds. But Catholic schools in the state do not accept religious exemptions; Florida's Catholic dioceses support vaccination and recognize no theological argument against it. The schools only accept exemptions based on medical conditions that are verified by a healthcare provider. Uthmeier, himself a Catholic, wrote to the bishops in an open letter that, based on his own understanding of Catholicism, he saw " no legitimate religious reason to refuse granting religious exemptions ." He reviewed select theological positions regarding the use of "abortion-derived vaccines," and suggested to the bishops that it was "morally reprehensible" that they not grant religious exemptions. title.en: Google announces Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for AI-powered speech-to-text
title.zh: 谷歌宣布推出 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，用于人工智能驱动的语音转文本

summary.en: The AI that powers Gboard's Rambler is coming to more Google products, including Chrome.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: While we wait ( possibly in vain ) for Gemini 3.5 Pro to launch, Google is releasing a different model in the 3.5 branch. The company has announced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, an AI model designed to streamline voice input by editing out "ums" and corrections, outputting polished AI text. This model already powers the Gboard "Rambler" feature on the Pixel 11 , but it's about to appear throughout the Google ecosystem. According to Google, Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is much faster and more accurate than its previous voice-to-text engine, known as Chirp 3. The new AI model should be about 70 percent faster from voice to final transcribed text, and the live-speech error rate has dropped to 5.5 percent. That's only a little better than Chirp 3, which Google measures at 7.32 percent. Still, it's a pain to fix typos when you're using voice input, so any improvement here is beneficial. title.en: The Porsche 911 GT3 Touring punches above its weight class
title.zh: 保时捷 911 GT3 Touring 超越其重量级

summary.en: The "everyday" GT3 delivers, despite looming regulations and an ever-inflating price tag.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The GT3 occupies a singular place in the 911 lineup. Whereas the range-topping Turbo S piles on power, technology, luxury, and all-weather capability, the GT3 has always pursued something more elemental: a lighter weight, more focus, and a finely honed setup that puts the driver at the center of the experience. Porsche has expanded the GT3 formula since the model’s debut in 1999, adding the more extreme GT3 RS to the lineup in 2003 and the slightly more reserved GT3 Touring in 2017, along with the GT3 S/C earlier this year. While the concept behind the drop-top S/C requires some mental gymnastics to make sense of it, the Touring’s original premise was refreshingly simple: Take the standard GT3—including its naturally aspirated 4.0 L flat-six and track-tuned chassis—and replace the fixed rear wing with the deployable spoiler from the Carrera. The result is a subtler version of the homologation car that recaptures the classic 911 silhouette without giving up the hardware that makes a GT3 a GT3. Fresh from its 992.2 mid-cycle update, the latest GT3 Touring sticks closely to that original design. Its 4.0 L flat-six still spins to 9,000 rpm and produces 502 hp (375 kW) and 331 lb-ft (449 Nm), sending its output exclusively to the rear wheels through either a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic or six-speed manual gearbox. Massive brakes, rear-axle steering, a GT3-specific suspension, active sport exhaust, and plenty of other road course-oriented hardware remain standard. Read full article Comments
body.zh: GT3 在 911 系列中占有独特的地位。顶级 Turbo S 注重动力、技术、豪华和全天候能力，而 GT3 始终追求更基本的东西：更轻的重量、更专注，以及将驾驶员置于体验中心的精心设计的设置。自 1999 年首次亮相以来，保时捷不断扩展 GT3 的配方，于 2003 年在产品阵容中添加了更极端的 GT3 RS，在 2017 年添加了稍微保守的 GT3 Touring，以及今年早些时候的 GT3 S/C。虽然敞篷 S/C 背后的概念需要一些心理体操才能理解它，但 Touring 最初的前提非常简单：采用标准 GT3，包括其自然吸气 4.0 L 水平对置六缸和赛道调校底盘，并用 Carrera 的可展开扰流板取代固定尾翼。其结果是这款同系汽车的精妙版本，重现了经典 911 的轮廓，同时又不放弃让 GT3 成为 GT3 的硬件。刚刚完成 992.2 中期更新后，最新的 GT3 Touring 紧密贴合了原始设计。其 4.0 升水平对置六缸发动机的转速仍可达 9,000 转/分钟，可产生 502 马力（375 千瓦）和 331 磅英尺（449 牛米）的功率，通过七速 PDK 双离合自动变速箱或六速手动变速箱将其输出专门发送到后轮。大型制动器、后桥转向、GT3 专用悬架、主动运动排气以及许多其他面向道路路线的硬件仍然是标准配置。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Xbox boss 'thinking about affordability' of next-gen console
title.zh: Xbox 老板“考虑下一代游戏机的承受能力”

summary.en: In an exclusive interview with the BBC, Asha Sharma also discusses giving gamers digital versions of games they own.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Xbox chief executive Asha Sharma says the gaming giant needs to be "thinking about" affordability for its next-generation console, amid a "crisis" in computing prices.

In an interview with the BBC, she said rising hardware costs partly driven by AI spending mean firms need to find ways to make gaming affordable.

She also revealed gamers will soon be able to get digital versions of many of the physical games they currently own, potentially meaning their old games can be played on future Xbox consoles without having to put a disc in a drive.

"I know players love physical media, and I know there's a lot of benefits in digital media, and I want to make sure people have a choice," Sharma said.

Currently, digital games can be downloaded online and played across Xbox consoles or PCs.

But some players prefer discs, with one of the main benefits being they can be bought and sold second-hand.

The topic has proven controversial, with Sony announcing new PlayStation games will no longer be released on discs from January 2028 , and the hotly-anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI similarly launching without a physical disc .

"We're announcing the ability for players for 1,000 titles with physical discs to be able to have a digital entitlement."

If a disc is sold second-hand, the digital rights would transfer over to the new owner.

Players will be able to access the feature by inserting one of the supported games into their Xbox console. And Sharma hinted it meant gamers would be able to play their old titles on future hardware.

"We've long pioneered backwards compatibility and so you'll continue to see that as we go forward in the generations," she said.

But she would not reveal whether Xbox's next-generation console - currently codenamed Project Helix - will have a disc drive at all.

"This next generation, we have to be thinking about efficiency and affordability alongside performance," she added.

For the first time in the history of gaming, consoles across the board have seen price hikes years after they came out.

This is partly due to component costs such as Ram skyrocketing in price as AI companies buy up all the parts for their data centres.

"All of the industry needs to start to innovate on affordability and efficiency. That is something that we have not had to do [previously].

"But with the crisis that's currently happening in hardware and components , it is absolutely something all of us need to be thinking about and innovating on and giving people more choice in terms of how they play their console and how they purchase their console."

Xbox is part of Microsoft, which is one of the companies ploughing the most money into AI infrastructure, which in turn puts the prices of hardware components up.

body.zh: Xbox 首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马 (Asha Sharma) 表示，在计算价格的“危机”中，这家游戏巨头需要“考虑”其下一代游戏机的承受能力。 她在接受 BBC 采访时表示，硬件成本上涨在一定程度上是由人工智能支出推动的，这意味着公司需要找到让游戏价格实惠的方法。 她还透露，游戏玩家很快就能获得他们目前拥有的许多实体游戏的数字版本，这可能意味着他们的旧游戏可以在未来的 Xbox 游戏机上玩，而无需将光盘放入驱动器中。 “我知道玩家喜欢实体媒体，我也知道数字媒体有很多好处，我想确保人们有选择，”夏尔马说。 目前，数字游戏可以在线下载并在 Xbox 游戏机或 PC 上玩。 但有些玩家更喜欢光盘，其主要好处之一是可以买卖二手光盘。 事实证明，这个话题颇具争议，索尼宣布从 2028 年 1 月起，新的 PlayStation 游戏将不再以光盘形式发行，而备受期待的《侠盗猎车手 VI》也同样在没有实体光盘的情况下推出。 “我们宣布，拥有 1,000 款实体光盘游戏的玩家将能够获得数字授权。” 如果光盘被出售为二手，则数字版权将转移给新所有者。 玩家将能够通过将受支持的游戏之一插入其 Xbox 主机来访问该功能。夏尔马暗示，这意味着玩家将能够在未来的硬件上玩他们的旧游戏。 她说：“我们长期以来一直是向后兼容的先驱，因此，随着我们几代人的前进，您将继续看到这一点。” 但她不愿透露 Xbox 的下一代游戏机（目前代号为 Project Helix）是否会有光盘驱动器。 “对于下一代，我们必须在性能的同时考虑效率和承受能力，”她补充道。 游戏史上第一次，所有游戏机在问世多年后价格都出现上涨。 这在一定程度上是由于人工智能公司购买了数据中心的所有部件，导致 RAM 等部件成本飞涨。 “整个行业都需要开始在可承受性和效率方面进行创新。这是我们（以前）不需要做的事情。 “但鉴于目前硬件和组件领域正在发生的危机，这绝对是我们所有人都需要思考和创新的事情，并为人们在如何玩游戏机以及如何购买游戏机方面提供更多选择。” Xbox 是微软的一部分，微软是在人工智能基础设施上投入最多资金的公司之一，这反过来又推高了硬件组件的价格。 “我们作为 Xbox 的工作，我们将继续我们的下一个......

title.en: With the end of physical media in sight, gamers have had enough
title.zh: 随着物理媒体的终结在望，游戏玩家已经受够了

summary.en: An increasing tension between players and publishers about ownership of titles could lead to a divestment from the system the big companies are trying to enforce At the time of press, there is a well-publicised protest taking place in the video games community. PlayStation 5...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: An increasing tension between players and publishers about ownership of titles could lead to a divestment from the system the big companies are trying to enforce At the time of press, there is a well-publicised protest taking place in the video games community. PlayStation 5 owners are being encouraged to log off from their consoles between 23 and 30 August – no playing games, no downloading new titles. The motivating factor is Sony’s decision to cease physical game disc production from January 2028. After that, games will only be released as digital products. In an act of poor timing or wilful defiance, Sony chose this week to send out a mass email reminding customers of their PS5 terms and conditions: “The software is licensed to you, not sold,” states the relevant clause. “You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and personal license to play … ” It knows, of course, that most customers won’t open the email, let alone read it. There has always been a tension between game players and game publishers – an underlying sense of mutual mistrust. Players are wary of their favourite franchises being canned, or games being delayed or released with bugs. Publishers and manufacturers are wary of piracy and the capricious tastes of consumers. But now the atmosphere among many game players feels more starkly political than ever. Microsoft has been targeted by the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions movement for its ties to the Israeli military ; the consumer advocacy group Stop Killing Games is gaining support; players have protested over the purchase of Electronic Arts by a Saudi-led consortium – boycotts have been proposed in part due to the possible ramifications regarding LGBTQ+ content in titles such as The Sims. As the games industry has grown and globalised, its impact on culture, society and politics has increased. Yet, on an individual level, gamers and consumers are feeling increasingly powerless. Continue reading...
body.zh: 玩家和发行商之间关于游戏所有权的紧张关系可能会导致大公司从试图强制执行的系统中撤资。截至发稿时，视频游戏界正在发生一场广为人知的抗议活动。我们鼓励 PlayStation 5 用户在 8 月 23 日至 30 日期间退出游戏机，不要玩游戏，也不要下载新游戏。推动因素是索尼决定从2028年1月起停止实体游戏光盘的生产。此后游戏将仅以数字产品形式发行。索尼选择在本周发送大量电子邮件，提醒客户他们的 PS5 条款和条件，这是一种不合时宜或故意反抗的行为：“该软件是授权给您的，而不是出售的，”相关条款指出。 “您被授予有限的、非独占的、不可转让的个人许可来玩……”当然，它知道大多数客户不会打开电子邮件，更不用说阅读它了。游戏玩家和游戏发行商之间一直存在紧张关系——一种潜在的相互不信任感。玩家对他们最喜欢的系列被取消、游戏被延迟或发布带有错误持谨慎态度。出版商和制造商对盗版和消费者反复无常的品味保持警惕。但现在许多游戏玩家的政治氛围比以往任何时候都更加明显。微软因其与以色列军方的关系而成为抵制、撤资、制裁运动的目标；消费者权益倡导组织“停止杀戮游戏”正在获得支持；玩家们对沙特阿拉伯领导的财团收购艺电公司提出抗议——提议抵制的部分原因是《模拟人生》等游戏中 LGBTQ+ 内容可能产生的影响。随着游戏产业的发展和全球化，它对文化、社会和政治的影响也随之增加。然而，在个人层面上，游戏玩家和消费者却感到越来越无能为力。继续阅读...

title.en: Vholume review – a headlong rush of parkour perfection in a brutalist wonderland
title.zh: Vholume评测——残酷仙境中的跑酷完美主义的狂奔

summary.en: Vholume is a PC game featuring parkour across dystopian cityscapes, characterized by wall-runs, daring leaps, and split-second improvisation. The game draws inspiration from titles like Mirror's Edge and environments reminiscent of Half-Life 2 and de Chirico's art, showcasing a curated and tasteful design.
summary.zh: Vholume是一款PC游戏，玩家将在反乌托邦的城市景观中进行跑酷，特色是飞檐走壁、大胆跳跃和瞬时反应。游戏借鉴了《镜之边缘》等作品的灵感，并融入了类似《半条命2》和德·基里科艺术风格的环境，展现出一种精心策划且品味不俗的设计。

body.en: PC; Nathan Grange, Léonard Lemaitre, Niels Tiercelin, IronEqual Race across impossible dystopian cityscapes in this exhilarating game of wall-runs, death-chancing leaps and split-second improvisation At first, Vholume seems like a quick rush through some smartly selected references. Has this breathless yet austere parkour game been designed or ingeniously curated? The urban gymnast moveset comes from Mirror’s Edge. Level names use terms like conapt, first coined by Philip K Dick. And the environments themselves are dystopian and surreal, Half-Life 2’s City 17 colliding with the blasted avenues and mute archways of de Chirico. Many games have influences. Vholume has actual taste. All the surface stuff fades away when the game is in motion, however. Vholume’s an on-foot racing game in which you hoof it through spectacularly odd environments, moving from one beam of concrete to the next. You’re clipping your wall-runs and power-slides together to bridge seemingly impossible gaps between buildings, forever in search of the next stretch of track, the next turn, the next jump that gets you to the level’s exit and the worldwide leaderboards. And once that’s done, you have a choice: onwards to another gauntlet, or back to the start of this one again to slice a few microseconds off your score? Or maybe you’d rather head over to multiplayer to race against the ghosts of others? Continue reading...
body.zh: 个人电脑;内森·格兰奇 (Nathan Grange)、莱昂纳德·勒梅特 (Léonard Lemaitre)、尼尔斯·蒂尔塞林 (Niels Tiercelin)、IronEqual 在这款令人兴奋的跑墙游戏、致命的跳跃和瞬间即兴创作中，穿越不可能的反乌托邦城市景观。 起初，Vholume 似乎是快速浏览一些精心挑选的参考资料。这款令人窒息却又朴素的跑酷游戏是精心设计还是精心策划的？城市体操运动员的动作来自《镜之边缘》。级别名称使用 conapt 等术语，该术语最初由 Philip K Dick 创造。环境本身也是反乌托邦和超现实的，《半条命 2》中的 17 号城与德基里科的破败大道和无声拱门相互碰撞。许多游戏都有影响。 Vholume 有真正的味道。然而，当游戏进行时，所有表面的东西都会消失。 Vholume 是一款徒步竞速游戏，在其中，你要踩着蹄子穿过极其奇怪的环境，从一根混凝土梁移动到另一根混凝土梁。你将墙壁滑行和动力滑梯剪在一起，以弥合建筑物之间看似不可能的间隙，永远在寻找下一段轨道、下一个转弯、下一个跳跃，让你到达关卡的出口和全球排行榜。一旦完成，你就可以选择：继续进行另一场挑战，还是再次回到这一挑战的开始，以减少你的分数几微秒？或者也许您更愿意进入多人游戏来与其他人的幽灵竞赛？继续阅读...

reflection.en: In Vholume, players navigate complex, surreal cityscapes, blending influences from various media into a cohesive and exhilarating experience. This mirrors Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times, where human ingenuity and curated information create new forms of expression and understanding. As technology advances, we see ever more...
reflection.zh: 在《Vholume》中，玩家穿梭于复杂、超现实的城市景观，将各种媒介的影响融合成一种令人振奋的体验。这呼应了但以理关于末世知识增长的预言，人类的创造力和精心策划的信息催生了新的表达和理解形式。 随着科技的进步，我们看到像这款游戏这样日益精妙的作品，源于人类知识的积累和艺术的融合。愿我们明智地运用这日益增长的理解力，反映造物主自身精妙的设计。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: AI gold rush draws crypto firms away from Bitcoin
title.zh: 人工智能淘金热吸引加密公司放弃比特币

summary.en: Companies that previously invested heavily in Bitcoin mining are now re-purposing their powerful computer infrastructure to support artificial intelligence development. This shift is occurring as Bitcoin's price has fallen significantly from its peak, while the AI sector is attracting billions in investment.
summary.zh: 曾大量投资比特币挖矿的公司，现在正将其强大的计算机基础设施重新用于支持人工智能开发。这一转变发生之际，比特币价格已从峰值大幅下跌，而人工智能领域正吸引着数十亿美元的投资。

body.en:
Companies that once filled warehouses with computers to earn Bitcoin - a process known as mining - are now using that computing power for AI.

Bitcoin mining companies invested large sums on giant banks of powerful computers as the price of Bitcoin rocketed in recent years .

But those mining companies have faced falling rewards since the value of the cryptocurrency has slumped from its peak in October 2025.

Now many are pivoting to AI and signing deals with companies such as Anthropic - who are spending billions of dollars on the infrastructure needed to keep up in the AI race.

Like AI systems, Bitcoin relies on vast networks of powerful computers housed in data centres.

Because Bitcoin operates without a central authority, these computers verify transactions and are rewarded with newly-created digital coins.

But the rewards have reduced and the value of coins has dropped since last year.

One bitcoin was worth about $124,000 (£91,000) at its peak in October 2025, but has since fallen sharply.

More recently, it has rallied to around $80,000 - meaning it is up almost 30% so far in August.

But, for companies that have already made the change, even that may not be enough to get them to return to the crypto industry, because the switch of use - once made - is expensive to undo.

Industry analysts say Bitcoin mining companies have been pivoting to AI because they have years of experience in finding cheap electricity and efficiently running large data centres.

TerraWulf, Ionic Digital, Core Scientific, Iris Energy, Bitdeer, Riot Platforms and Hut 8 are just some of the companies increasingly diverting investment and infrastructure from bitcoin mining towards AI.

Riot Platforms signed a $9bn, 20-year compute deal with Anthropic earlier this month.

TerraWulf's website once described the firm as an "infrastructure-focused bitcoin mining company".

Enegix, which opened a huge Bitcoin mining site in Kazakhstan to great fanfare in 2020, is now pivoting too.

"Today, we are moving confidently towards artificial intelligence and planning the gradual alignment of our energy and infrastructure capabilities, both in Kazakhstan and elsewhere, towards the development of AI infrastructure," said the company's chief executive Yerbolsyn Sarsenov.

Enegix says it is in active discussions with AI and HPC (high-performance computing) companies and planning to transform a "significant" portion of the business to AI.

But refitting crypto mines for AI is expensive and in some cases the companies have had to sell some of their Bitcoin holdings to fund the switch.

Wolfie Zhao from The Energy Mag - a publication that rebranded from The Miner Mag to reflect the trend - predicts the industry pivot will continue even as the price of Bitcoin has risen in recent days.

"We...
body.zh: 曾经在仓库里装满计算机来赚取比特币的公司（这一过程称为挖矿）现在正在将这种计算能力用于人工智能。 近年来，随着比特币价格的飙升，比特币挖矿公司向拥有强大计算机的巨型银行投入了大量资金。 但自从加密货币的价值从 2025 年 10 月的峰值下跌以来，这些矿业公司面临着回报下降的局面。 现在，许多人正在转向人工智能，并与 Anthropic 等公司签署协议——这些公司正花费数十亿美元购买人工智能竞赛所需的基础设施。 与人工智能系统一样，比特币依赖于数据中心内强大计算机组成的庞大网络。 由于比特币的运行没有中央权威，这些计算机会验证交易并获得新创建的数字硬币的奖励。 但从去年开始，奖励减少了，硬币的价值也下降了。 一枚比特币在 2025 年 10 月达到峰值时价值约 124,000 美元（91,000 英镑），但此后急剧下跌。 最近，它已反弹至 80,000 美元左右，这意味着 8 月份迄今已上涨近 30%。 但是，对于已经做出改变的公司来说，即使这样也可能不足以让他们重返加密货币行业，因为一旦改变用途，撤销的成本就很高。 行业分析师表示，比特币挖矿公司一直在转向人工智能，因为他们在寻找廉价电力和高效运行大型数据中心方面拥有多年的经验。 TerraWulf、Ionic Digital、Core Scientific、Iris Energy、Bitdeer、Riot Platforms 和 Hut 8 只是越来越多地将投资和基础设施从比特币挖矿转向人工智能的公司中的一部分。 Riot Platforms 本月早些时候与 Anthropic 签署了一项价值 90 亿美元、为期 20 年的计算协议。 TerraWulf 的网站曾将该公司描述为“一家专注于基础设施的比特币挖矿公司”。 Enegix 于 2020 年在哈萨克斯坦大张旗鼓地开设了一个大型比特币矿场，现在也正在转型。 该公司首席执行官 Yerbolsyn Sarsenov 表示：“今天，我们充满信心地迈向人工智能，并计划逐步调整我们在哈萨克斯坦和其他地方的能源和基础设施能力，以发展人工智能基础设施。” Enegix 表示，它正在与人工智能和 HPC（高性能计算）公司进行积极讨论，并计划将业务的“重要”部分转变为人工智能。 但为人工智能改造加密货币矿场成本高昂，在某些情况下，这些公司不得不出售部分比特币资产来为这一转变提供资金。 《能源杂志》（为反映这一趋势而从《矿工杂志》更名为《能源杂志》）的 Wolfie Zhu 预测，尽管比特币价格最近几天有所上涨，但行业的重心仍将持续。 “我们...

reflection.en: The rapid pivot of crypto firms from Bitcoin mining to AI, driven by market shifts and the promise of new billions, highlights the transient nature of earthly pursuits. Just as Bitcoin's value slumped from its peak, so too can any treasure we store up on earth prove fleeting. This story invites us to consider where our true and lasting investments lie.
reflection.zh: 加密货币公司因市场变化和数十亿美元的新机遇，迅速从比特币挖矿转向人工智能，这突显了世俗追求的短暂性。正如比特币的价值从高峰跌落一样，我们积攒在地上的一切财宝也可能转瞬即逝。这个故事邀请我们思考，我们真正持久的投资在哪里。

verse.textEn: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moths and vermin destroy.
verse.textZh: 不要为自己积攒财宝在地上；地上有虫子咬，能锈坏。

title.en: Development banks are backing problematic mineral projects, report finds
title.zh: 报告发现，开发银行正在支持有问题的矿产项目

summary.en: “Development bank-backed transition minerals projects are frequently associated with significant environmental, social, and human rights risks.” This is the conclusion of the latest report by the International Accountability Project (IAP), an international advocacy organization....
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: “Development bank-backed transition minerals projects are frequently associated with significant environmental, social, and human rights risks.” This is the conclusion of the latest report by the International Accountability Project (IAP), an international advocacy organization. IAP analyzed 77 projects globally, approved between 2023 and 2025. The analysis resulted in the Transition Minerals Finance Tracker, an interactive online database documenting transition minerals projects. It reveals that more than half of the projects analyzed, and nearly three-quarters of African projects, show evidence of actual, probable or potential harm to local communities. “There are many companies that are multinational mining corporations who have a very bad track record in terms of human rights, yet they do get loans from the development banks,” Vaishnavi Varadarajan, program coordinator at IAP, told Mongabay in a phone interview. “It is raising the question of the due diligence that is being done by the banks beforehand.” Since the Paris Agreement in 2015, a growing number of countries are investing in renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power as well as electric vehicles to limit their greenhouse gas emissions. Such technologies require components made from minerals and rare earth elements that are often found in the Global South and shipped to the Global North for value-added processing, Varadarajan said. “[I]t is kind of reinforcing a colonial way of extraction.” The report denounces an unfair transition, in which countries financing extraction reap most of the economic benefits, while countries where raw materials are located face water depletion and contamination,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: “开发银行支持的过渡矿产项目经常与重大环境、社会和人权风险相关。”这是国际倡导组织国际问责项目（IAP）最新报告的结论。 IAP 分析了全球 77 个项目，这些项目在 2023 年至 2025 年间获得批准。分析结果产生了过渡矿物财务追踪器，这是一个记录过渡矿物项目的交互式在线数据库。报告显示，超过一半的分析项目以及近四分之三的非洲项目都显示出对当地社区造成实际、可能或潜在损害的证据。 IAP 项目协调员瓦什纳维·瓦拉达拉詹 (Vaishnavi Varadarajan) 在接受 Mongabay 电话采访时表示：“许多跨国矿业公司在人权方面的记录非常糟糕，但他们却从开发银行获得了贷款。” “这引发了银行事先进行的尽职调查的问题。”自2015年《巴黎协定》签署以来，越来越多的国家开始投资太阳能、风能以及电动汽车等可再生能源，以限制温室气体排放。 Varadarajan 表示，此类技术需要由矿物和稀土元素制成的组件，这些元素通常在南半球发现，并运往北半球进行增值加工。 “这在某种程度上强化了殖民主义的榨取方式。”该报告谴责了一种不公平的转型，在这种转型中，为开采提供资金的国家获得了大部分经济利益，而原材料所在地的国家却面临着水资源枯竭和污染的问题……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Pastoralists in a Changing World
title.zh: 不断变化的世界中的牧民

summary.en: Pastoralism is one of humanity’s oldest ways of life. Moving livestock across vast landscapes in rhythm with seasonal change and environmental conditions, pastoralist cultures rely on freedom of movement and shared arrangements over how to graze rangelands. Today, pastoralists...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及在压力下的忠信与属灵勇气。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Pastoralism is one of humanity’s oldest ways of life. Moving livestock across vast landscapes in rhythm with seasonal change and environmental conditions, pastoralist cultures rely on freedom of movement and shared arrangements over how to graze rangelands. Today, pastoralists are navigating profound environmental changes to the lands that have sustained their communities for generations. This Special Issue explores many of the tensions influencing pastoral livelihoods including climate change, conflict with wildlife, access to land, water and traditional migration routes, as well as the adaptation and innovation sustaining hundreds of millions of people worldwide. This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 畜牧业是人类最古老的生活方式之一。随着季节变化和环境条件的变化，牲畜在广阔的土地上迁徙，牧民文化依赖于迁徙自由和牧场放牧方式的共同安排。如今，牧民正在经历深刻的环境变化，他们的土地支撑着他们的社区世代相传。本期特刊探讨了影响牧民生计的许多紧张局势，包括气候变化、与野生动物的冲突、土地、水和传统迁徙路线的获取，以及维持全世界数亿人生存的适应和创新。本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Kenya’s clothing waste raises concerns about potential public health risks
title.zh: 肯尼亚的衣物浪费引发了对潜在公共健康风险的担忧

summary.en: Kenya’s secondhand clothing trade, locally known as mitumba, clothes millions of people and supports an estimated 2 million livelihoods, making it one of Africa’s largest markets for used garments. That makes Kenya a useful lens for understanding the growing global public health...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Kenya’s secondhand clothing trade, locally known as mitumba, clothes millions of people and supports an estimated 2 million livelihoods, making it one of Africa’s largest markets for used garments. That makes Kenya a useful lens for understanding the growing global public health problems associated with textile waste disguised as reusable clothing. More than 4.5 billion used garments are shipped to Africa each year, according to a recent letter published in Science. Many end up in dumpsites or are burned when local sorting systems are overwhelmed. The researchers argue that discarded textile waste can become reservoirs for harmful bacteria, including Escherichia (which includes E. coli) and Klebsiella. These bacteria are linked to illnesses ranging from diarrheal disease and urinary tract infections to pneumonia, bloodstream infections and, in severe cases, life-threatening sepsis. A growing body of research links health risks with textile waste. A recent review found that discarded textiles can harbor pathogenic microorganisms and antimicrobial-resistant genes. Another study showed that microplastics released from degrading synthetic textiles can transport pathogens and toxic chemicals through the environment. Recent reporting by Mongabay highlighted evidence that microplastic pollution may contribute to the spread of antibiotic resistance. For Kenya, the enormous scale of the secondhand clothing trade is at the root of the problem. A 2023 report estimates that Nairobi’s largest dumpsite receives roughly 86 metric tons of textile waste each day. Once discarded, synthetic textiles can fragment into microplastics that pollute both the air and waterways. To combat the problem, the authors of the Science…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 肯尼亚的二手服装贸易在当地被称为“mitumba”，为数百万人提供衣服，并支持约 200 万人的生计，使其成为非洲最大的二手服装市场之一。这使得肯尼亚成为了解与伪装成可重复使用服装的纺织废料相关的日益严重的全球公共卫生问题的有用镜头。根据《科学》杂志最近发表的一封信，每年有超过 45 亿件旧衣服被运往非洲。当当地的分类系统不堪重负时，许多东西最终被扔进垃圾场或被烧毁。研究人员认为，废弃的纺织废料可能成为有害细菌的储存库，包括大肠杆菌（Escherichia）和克雷伯氏菌（Klebsiella）。这些细菌与腹泻、尿路感染、肺炎、血液感染等多种疾病有关，严重时还可能导致危及生命的败血症。越来越多的研究将健康风险与纺织废料联系起来。最近的一项审查发现，废弃的纺织品可能含有病原微生物和抗菌素耐药基因。另一项研究表明，降解的合成纺织品释放的微塑料可以在环境中传播病原体和有毒化学物质。 Mongabay 最近的报告强调了微塑料污染可能导致抗生素耐药性蔓延的证据。对于肯尼亚来说，规模庞大的二手服装贸易才是问题的根源。 2023 年的一份报告估计，内罗毕最大的垃圾场每天接收约 86 吨纺织废料。一旦被丢弃，合成纺织品就会碎裂成微塑料，污染空气和水道。为了解决这个问题，《科学》杂志的作者……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

title.en: Birds have an eerie association with death | Letter
title.zh: 鸟与死亡的诡异关联 | 信件

summary.en: Responding to a story about birds comforting someone during bereavement, a letter writer shares her own experience of a wren flying into her classroom and being found dead on the day her mother-in-law died, contrasting with another friend's belief that birds contacting them were spirits of the deceased.
summary.zh: 一位读者在回应一篇关于鸟类在丧亲之痛中安慰人们的文章时，分享了她自己的经历：在她婆婆去世的那天，一只鹪鹩飞进了她的教室，并在地上被发现死亡。这与另一位朋友的经历形成对比，那位朋友认为接触她的鸟是已故亲人的灵魂。

body.en: Responding to an article in which birds comforted Helen Harris during bereavement, Angela Smith describes her own experience Helen Harris’s experience ( A moment that changed me: my husband died – and birds began behaving strangely towards me, 19 August ) chimes with that of a friend of mine who had many close encounters with robins after the death of her father. She too had birds flying into her house as never before but, unlike Helen, she believed that this was the person’s spirit making contact. My own association between birds and death is rather different. The day my mother-in-law died, a wren had flown into the window of the classroom where I taught, and I found it dead on the ground outside. When we took her ashes to be scattered in the sea, a pheasant hit the car windscreen and died. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安吉拉·史密斯在回应一篇关于鸟儿在海伦·哈里斯丧亲之痛时安慰她的文章时，描述了她自己的经历。海伦·哈里斯的经历（改变我的时刻：我的丈夫死了——鸟儿开始对我表现得很奇怪，8 月 19 日）与我的一个朋友的经历不谋而合，她在父亲去世后与知更鸟有过多次亲密接触。她也有鸟儿前所未有地飞进她的房子，但与海伦不同的是，她相信这是人的灵魂在接触。我自己对鸟类与死亡的联系则相当不同。我婆婆去世的那天，一只鹪鹩飞进了我任教的教室的窗户，我发现它死在外面的地上。当我们把她的骨灰撒到海里时，一只野鸡撞到了汽车挡风玻璃死了。继续阅读...

This personal observation, alongside another's belief in spiritual contact through birds, touches on the deep mysteries of life, death, and the natural world. The Psalmist marvels at the intricate wisdom woven into creation, reminding us...
reflection.zh: 作者分享了一个令人伤感的巧合：在她婆婆去世的同一天，一只鹪鹩在她教室里被发现死亡。这个个人观察，以及另一位朋友相信鸟类是逝者的灵魂的说法，触及了生命、死亡和自然界的深层奥秘。诗人惊叹于雅伟创造中编织的精妙智慧，提醒我们即使在悲伤中，祂浩瀚的作为也环绕着我们。

body.en:
A study from Scotland found that living near an accessible urban woodland significantly lowered the likelihood of being prescribed antidepressants.

The research focused on Scotland’s Woods In and Around Towns program , which aims to plant, restore, or protect woodlands in deprived neighborhoods and make them accessible to the public by installing signs, trails, and walking paths. Launched in 2005, the WIAT program has revitalized nearly 30,000 acres of urban woodlands.

From the beginning, one of the central aims of the program has been to improve mental health. To gauge its success, researchers at the Universities of Edinburgh and Glasgow tracked more than 129,000 people across Scotland over five years. They found that when people moved to within a 10-minute walk of a WIAT woodland, their odds of being prescribed an antidepressant dropped by 10 percent, while their odds of being prescribed anti-anxiety medication dropped by 6 percent.

“Our results tell us that relatively modest investments in local green spaces can make a real difference to people’s mental health,” said lead author Scott Ogletree of the University of Edinburgh. The findings were published in The Lancet Planetary Health .

A host of prior studies have found that living near green spaces can reduce stress , improve moods , and lower the risk of developing anxiety or depression. Some research has even found that exposure to nature can help reduce violent crime. In light of the well-documented benefits of living near green spaces, the World Health Organization recommends urban planners establish at least 1 acre of green space within 1,000 feet of every home.
body.zh: 苏格兰的一项研究发现，居住在可到达的城市林地附近会显着降低服用抗抑郁药物的可能性。 该研究重点关注苏格兰城镇内及周边的森林计划，该计划旨在种植、恢复或保护贫困社区的林地，并通过安装标志、小径和步行道使公众能够进入这些林地。 WIAT 计划于 2005 年启动，已振兴了近 30,000 英亩的城市林地。 从一开始，该计划的中心目标之一就是改善心理健康。为了衡量其成功程度，爱丁堡大学和格拉斯哥大学的研究人员在五年内对苏格兰各地超过 129,000 人进行了追踪。他们发现，当人们搬到距离 WIAT 林地 10 分钟步行路程的地方时，他们服用抗抑郁药物的几率会下降 10%，而服用抗焦虑药物的几率会下降 6%。 “我们的结果告诉我们，对当地绿地的相对适度的投资可以对人们的心理健康产生真正的影响，”爱丁堡大学的主要作者斯科特·奥格特里说。研究结果发表在《柳叶刀行星健康》上。 先前的大量研究发现，居住在绿色空间附近可以减轻压力，改善情绪，并降低患焦虑或抑郁的风险。一些研究甚至发现，接触大自然有助于减少暴力犯罪。鉴于居住在绿色空间附近的好处已得到充分证明，世界卫生组织建议城市规划者在每个家庭 1,000 英尺范围内至少建立 1 英亩的绿色空间。

body.en: Even low levels of traffic noise can negate the benefits of listening to natural sounds, researchers say Hearing the trill or whistle of a bird while going about daily life is well known to boost people’s mood. But a new study suggests the psychological benefits of hearing birdsong are being threatened by traffic noise. Researchers found that even low levels of traffic noise negatively affected the benefits to wellbeing that could otherwise be derived from listening to natural sounds. Continue reading...

reflection.zh: 这项研究提醒我们，自然界拥有一种修复性的声音，需要我们安静聆听才能领受。当现代生活的喧嚣淹没了鸟鸣，我们也失去了一个简单而深刻的途径，那是雅伟向我们疲惫的心灵诉说平安的方式。

title.en: Bomb Fishing Is Wreaking Havoc on Indonesia's Coral Reefs
title.zh: 炸弹捕鱼正在摧毁印度尼西亚的珊瑚礁

summary.en: Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”
summary.zh: 研究人员估计，在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛沿岸作业的渔民每年引爆超过8,000枚水下炸药。这种做法正在将风景如画的珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Inside Climate News and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Fishers operating off the coast of Sulawesi, Indonesia, are detonating more than 8,000 underwater explosives each year, researchers estimate. The practice is turning picturesque coral reefs to “rubble.”

Nicknamed the “Amazon of the Seas,” the Coral Triangle is the world’s most biologically diverse marine ecosystem. Sink below the surface and you’ll encounter the sound of a vibrant symphony of snapping shrimp, crunching crustaceans, and feeding fish.

But then the rhythmic music of life will dissolve into eerie silence, punctured only by the plosive boom of detonating bombs.

Off the coast of Indonesia’s Spermonde Archipelago, underwater microphones captured over 3,500 explosions in just 3,600 hours of recording, according to researchers from the Zoological Society of London.

The source? Blast fishing — a globally banned technique that uses plastic bottles packed with explosives to stun and kill everything in a 90-foot radius. The highly destructive practice has been documented in at least 34 countries, from Lebanon and Libya to Brazil and Ecuador.

While fishers predominantly use the method to catch fish for sale at local markets — identifiable by their ruptured internal organs and burst swim bladders — it’s also a grave threat to colorful coral reef habitats.

“Bomb fishing is quite likely the leading cause of reef loss in this area,” said Ben Williams, the paper’s lead author, noting that a single bomb can wreak 200 square feet of destruction. “These picturesque reefs get converted into a landscape that looks like the moon. It’s just rubble and dead coral with very little sign of life.”

In 2023, researchers from Britain and Indonesia snorkeled down and anchored $150 audio recorders to short stakes in the seafloor. Using A.I. software — which the team has now made open-source — they scoured 16 months of audio in just a few hours to identify possible detonations.

While the A.I. filtered suspected cases, each suggested sound wave was then manually verified to assess if it stemmed from a bomb or a misfiring boat engine.

With sound traveling over four times faster through water than air, the team of marine scientists were able to detect detonations from over 10 miles away.

“When [the bombs] are close, it’s so loud that it can shake you out of your skin,” said Williams. “But if you put your head up on the surface, you probably can’t even see the boat that did it.”

Accounting for stormy-season setbacks and spearfishermen who tampered with the recorders, the team calculated that there were likely more than 8,500 blasts each year — all within an area of just 350 square miles.

body.zh: 本文最初由《内部气候新闻》发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 研究人员估计，在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛海岸作业的渔民每年会引爆 8,000 多枚水下炸药。这种做法正在将风景如画的珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”。 珊瑚三角区被誉为“海洋亚马逊”，是世界上生物多样性最丰富的海洋生态系统。沉入水面以下，您会听到虾虾、甲壳类动物咀嚼和鱼儿喂食的充满活力的交响乐声。 但随后，生命的节奏音乐将消失在令人毛骨悚然的寂静中，只有炸弹爆炸的爆炸声刺破这一切。 据伦敦动物学会的研究人员称，在印度尼西亚斯佩蒙德群岛海岸附近，水下麦克风在短短 3,600 小时的记录中捕捉到了 3,500 多次爆炸。 来源？爆破捕鱼——一种全球禁止的技术，使用装有炸药的塑料瓶来击晕并杀死 90 英尺半径内的所有物体。从黎巴嫩、利比亚到巴西和厄瓜多尔，至少有 34 个国家记录了这种极具破坏性的做法。 虽然渔民主要使用这种方法捕捞鱼类并在当地市场出售（可以通过内脏破裂和鱼鳔破裂来识别），但它也对色彩缤纷的珊瑚礁栖息地构成严重威胁。 该论文的主要作者本·威廉姆斯 (Ben Williams) 表示：“炸弹捕鱼很可能是该地区珊瑚礁消失的主要原因。”他指出，一枚炸弹就可以造成 200 平方英尺的破坏。 “这些风景如画的珊瑚礁变成了看起来像月亮的景观。它只是碎石和死珊瑚，几乎没有生命迹象。” 2023 年，来自英国和印度尼西亚的研究人员潜入海底，将价值 150 美元的录音机固定在海底的短木桩上。使用人工智能该团队现已将软件开源，他们在短短几个小时内搜索了 16 个月的音频，以识别可能的爆炸。 虽然 A.I.过滤掉可疑病例后，每个建议的声波都会被手动验证，以评估它是否源于炸弹或失火的船发动机。 由于声音在水中传播的速度比空气中传播的速度快四倍多，海洋科学家团队能够探测到 10 英里外的爆炸。 “当[炸弹]靠近时，声音非常大，可以把你震得浑身不舒服，”威廉姆斯说。 “但如果你把头伸出水面，你可能甚至看不到那艘船。” 考虑到暴风雨季节的挫折和鱼叉渔民篡改记录仪的情况，该团队计算出每年可能发生超过 8,500 次爆炸——所有爆炸都发生在仅 350 平方英里的区域内。 每 62 分钟投下一颗炸弹，...

Yahweh's word warns that the love of money can lead to all kinds of evil, and here we see it turning vibrant ecosystems like the "Amazon of the Seas" into...
reflection.zh: 印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛沿岸的炸弹捕鱼每年引爆超过8,000枚炸药，将珊瑚礁变成“瓦砾”，这悲剧性地提醒我们，对眼前财富的追求如何能摧毁受造物。雅伟的话语警告说，贪财是万恶之根，在此我们看到它将“海洋亚马逊”这样充满活力的生态系统变为一片废墟和“诡异的寂静”。这种做法不仅伤害环境，最终也损害了依赖这些宝贵资源的社区的长期福祉。

title.en: One of the World's ‘Most Wanted’ Lost Fish Is Rediscovered
title.zh: 世界上最想要的一种丢失的鱼被重新发现

summary.en: On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
On a vast network of rivers flowing through the jungles of Papua New Guinea, researchers have rediscovered the spinach pipefish, a relative of the seahorse, which had not been recorded in more than 40 years. The fish has long been sought after by conservationists, who feared it had gone extinct.

On an expedition that unfolded like a search for a missing person, researchers spent two weeks traversing the Sepik River and its tributaries, scouring villages and markets for evidence of the missing pipefish. They showed its photo to fishers, vendors, and village elders and asked where it might be found.

The task was daunting. The Sepik River extends across 700 miles of forests, floodplains, and wetlands along the northern coast of Papua New Guinea. “Travel is almost entirely by motorized boat or canoe, often taking many hours between villages,” said Jerrica Agebigo of the New Guinea Binatang Research Centre. The vast scale of the river system meant that scientists were heavily reliant on local knowledge.

In interviews, villagers consistently reported spotting a long, slender fish in the shallows of the Sepik River. Though they called the fish many names — Karuweng , Inap , Karuwena , Sako — their descriptions matched the profile of the missing species.

In the final days of the expedition, a fisher named Helen Asu managed to nab two pipefish using the handheld net she relied on to catch prawns. Researchers shared photos of her catch with Australian ichthyologist Gerald Allen, one of the last researchers to document the spinach pipefish in the 1980s. He confirmed the rediscovery.

“It makes my heart sing to hear that the spinach pipefish has been recorded anew,” said marine biologist Amanda Vincent, who chairs an expert group on seahorses, pipefishes, and seadragons for the International Union for Conservation of Nature. “To learn that the spinach pipefish still exists gives us hope that other ‘lost’ species are out there, too.”

The spinach pipefish had been named one of the 10 “most wanted” lost freshwater fish species by SHOAL, a U.K. conservation group. Its rediscovery highlights the urgency of protecting freshwater fish, the group said.

In interviews throughout the expedition, villagers reported declines of native fish, which are imperiled by mining, logging, and other threats. Globally, freshwater fish are under growing pressure. A recent U.N. report found that over the last half-century, populations of migratory freshwater fish have declined by 81 percent.
body.zh: 在流经巴布亚新几内亚丛林的广阔河流网络中，研究人员重新发现了菠菜尖嘴鱼，它是海马的近亲，这种鱼已有 40 多年没有记录。这种鱼长期以来一直受到自然资源保护者的追捧，他们担心它已经灭绝。 在一次像寻找失踪人员一样展开的探险中，研究人员花了两周时间穿越塞皮克河及其支流，在村庄和市场中搜寻失踪海龙鱼的证据。他们向渔民、商贩和村长展示了它的照片，并询问在哪里可以找到它。 这项任务是艰巨的。塞皮克河沿着巴布亚新几内亚北部海岸绵延 700 英里，横跨森林、洪泛区和湿地。新几内亚比纳唐研究中心的杰里卡·阿格比戈 (Jerrica Agebigo) 说：“旅行几乎完全依靠机动船或独木舟，在村庄之间通常需要花费很多小时。”河流系统规模庞大，意味着科学家严重依赖当地知识。 在采访中，村民们一致表示在塞皮克河的浅滩上发现了一条细长的鱼。尽管他们给这种鱼起了很多名字——Karuweng、Inap、Karuwena、Sako——但他们的描述与失踪物种的概况相符。 在探险的最后几天，一位名叫海伦·阿苏的渔民用她用来捕虾的手持网成功捕获了两条海龙。研究人员与澳大利亚鱼类学家杰拉尔德·艾伦 (Gerald Allen) 分享了她捕获的照片，杰拉尔德·艾伦是 20 世纪 80 年代最后记录菠菜尖嘴鱼的研究人员之一。他证实了这一重新发现。 国际自然保护联盟海马、海龙和海马专家组主席、海洋生物学家阿曼达·文森特 (Amanda Vincent) 表示：“听到菠菜海龙鱼被重新记录下来，我的心在歌唱。” “了解到菠菜尖嘴鱼仍然存在，让我们希望其他‘消失’的物种也在那里。” 菠菜尖嘴鱼被英国保护组织 SHOAL 评为 10 种“最想要”消失的淡水鱼类之一。该组织表示，它的重新发现凸显了保护淡水鱼的紧迫性。 在整个探险过程中的采访中，村民们报告说，由于采矿、伐木和其他威胁，本地鱼类数量减少。在全球范围内，淡水鱼面临着越来越大的压力。联合国最近的一份报告发现，在过去的半个世纪里，洄游淡水鱼的数量减少了 81%。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth. Proverbs 2:6 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with humble learning and wise application, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Hanging By a Wire review – cable car rescue documentary dangles viewers on the edge of disaster
title.zh: 《悬挂在钢丝上》影评——缆车救援纪录片让观众悬在灾难边缘

summary.en: The documentary "Hanging By a Wire" recounts the tense survival story of eight people trapped in a cable car above a chasm in Pakistan, featuring their extraordinary fate and daring rescue.
summary.zh: 纪录片《悬挂在钢丝上》讲述了八名被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方缆车中的人们惊心动魄的生存故事，展现了他们非凡的命运和大胆的救援行动。

body.en: The extraordinary fate of eight people trapped above a chasm in Pakistan makes for a tense, skilfully assembled survival story with unexpected flashes of comedy Survival documentaries are a weird little genre of nonfiction film-making that recount the stories of accidents and natural catastrophes – and more often than not, the daring rescues of people caught up in them. Eyewitnesses and the loved ones of those endangered are top of the interview list, to keep the sense of danger and emotional stakes at the top of everyone’s mind. Survivors can also have their say, and more adventurous film-makers might care to recreate the action with actors or the actual survivors themselves. This account of how eight people – six teenage boys and two adult men – were left suspended over a chasm in northern Pakistan in 2023, when a wire on the cable car they were travelling on broke, is a pretty conventional example of the form. For obvious reasons, no one tries to recreate the situation, but since it was quite recent there is no shortage of news footage and amateur clips to fill out the particulars. The downside of doing a story that’s so recent is that some of the audience may remember what happened anyway, but still there’s plenty of nail-nibbling suspense here, and sequences that will give anyone with acrophobia the heebie jeebies – especially the drone shots that zoom close on the terrified faces of those trapped inside the dangling car. Continue reading...
body.zh: 八个人被困在巴基斯坦的深渊上，他们的非凡命运造就了一个紧张而巧妙的生存故事，其中有意想不到的喜剧闪现。生存纪录片是一种奇怪的非虚构电影制作类型，讲述了事故和自然灾害的故事，而且往往讲述了被困人员的勇敢营救。目击者和那些濒临灭绝的人的亲人是采访的首要对象，以便让每个人都牢记危险感和情感风险。幸存者也可以发表意见，更具冒险精神的电影制作人可能会愿意与演员或真正的幸存者本人一起重现动作。这个故事描述了 2023 年，八个人（六名十几岁的男孩和两名成年男子）在巴基斯坦北部的一个峡谷上悬吊着，当时他们乘坐的缆车上的电线断裂了，这是这种形式的一个非常传统的例子。出于显而易见的原因，没有人试图重现这种情况，但由于这是最近发生的事情，因此不乏新闻片段和业余剪辑来填充细节。制作一个最近发生的故事的缺点是，一些观众可能会记得发生了什么，但这里仍然有很多令人紧张的悬念，以及会让任何有恐高症的人感到惊慌的序列——尤其是无人机拍摄的镜头，近距离拍摄那些被困在悬空的汽车里的人惊恐的面孔。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The harrowing ordeal of eight individuals suspended above a chasm in a Pakistani cable car reminds us of how vulnerable life can be when disaster strikes. In such moments of extreme peril, the human spirit yearns for a refuge and strength beyond its own, a help that is truly ever-present. Yahweh is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble,...
reflection.zh: 八名乘客被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方的缆车中，这惊心动魄的经历提醒我们，当灾难降临时，生命是多么脆弱。在如此极度的危险时刻，人的心灵渴望超越自身的力量，寻求一个真正无处不在的避难所和力量。雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助，当面对压倒性的挑战时，祂赐予我们安慰和支持。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Martin Short Explains Why He’s Never Seen a Shrink: ‘It’s OK to Be Sad’
title.zh: 马丁·肖特解释为何从未看过心理医生：‘悲伤是可以的’

summary.en: Canadian comedian Martin Short discussed with IndieWire how Lawrence Kasdan persuaded him to be the subject of the Netflix Emmy-nominated documentary, "Marty, Life Is Short." The documentary explores how Short navigated a series of profound personal tragedies, including the early deaths of his parents and brother, and...
summary.zh: 加拿大喜剧演员马丁·肖特向IndieWire讲述了劳伦斯·卡斯丹如何说服他成为Netflix艾美奖提名纪录片《马蒂，人生苦短》的主人公。这部纪录片探讨了肖特如何应对一系列深刻的个人悲剧，包括他父母和兄弟的早逝，以及他妻子和女儿最近的离世。

body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 我们都知道马丁·肖特很有趣。我们不知道的是，他如何经历了一系列类似约伯的个人悲剧，从父母和兄弟的早逝，到最近失去妻子和女儿。这就是我们从劳伦斯·卡斯丹的《马蒂，人生苦短》中学到的东西，该片获得三项黄金时段艾美奖提名（纪录片或特别奖、导演奖和剪辑奖）。肖特本人不仅凭借在 Netflix 的《大楼里的谋杀案》第五季中的喜剧表演再次获得最佳喜剧奖，还凭借 ABC 的《比赛游戏》获得最佳游戏节目主持人。 当肖特的老朋友卡斯丹建议制作一部关于他的纪录片时，这位喜剧演员表示反对。 “我是加拿大人，”他在 Zoom 采访中说道。 “我们比较保守一点。我在 2014 年还写了一本书，其中我的态度是开放的。然后，拉里在我的手机上给我留了一条八分钟的消息。[他说]我应该这样做，因为这对生活很重要。[他模仿卡斯丹标志性的鼻音。]我听到了，我说，‘好吧，我想我必须这样做，因为他一直说“他和罗恩”，而且我爱朗·霍华德。” 《皮特一家》、《她的错》等 2026 年 DARCYS TIFF 提名影片将表彰佩内洛普·克鲁兹、李沧东、范冰冰、海伦·米伦、伊莎贝尔·于佩尔等 肖特在主演卡斯丹制作的命运多舛的《Cross My Heart》（1987）时开始了与卡斯丹的关系。 “我们在这部电影中成为了好朋友，”他说。 “有时候，你会做出决定说，‘我不会让那个人离开。’我们都做到了，那是 40 年前的事了。” 对于纪录片导演卡斯丹来说幸运的是，肖特几十年来一直用摄像机记录他的生活。另一位好友史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格也提供了一些亲密的镜头。这部电影的电影亮点是对肖特和他深爱的已故妻子南希·多尔曼围绕他们建立的非凡好莱坞社区的一瞥。我们看到汤姆和丽塔、史蒂夫和凯特以及许多熟悉的面孔在戏水、玩耍、开玩笑，享受着他们的友情。 “多年来我一直被问到，‘和汤姆·汉克斯、史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格做朋友感觉如何？他们是什么样的人？’”肖特说。 “他们只是顽皮和朋友。他们只是碰巧出名。” 肖特总是有一个...

reflection.en: Martin Short's reflection on enduring "Job-like" personal tragedies, stating "It's OK to Be Sad," resonates deeply with the biblical truth that grief is a natural human response to loss. Even Yahweh, in human form, wept at the death of a friend, showing that sorrow is not a weakness but a profound expression of love and humanity. His ability to acknowledge...
reflection.zh: 马丁·肖特在经历“约伯式”个人悲剧后，表示“悲伤是可以的”，这与圣经中悲伤是人类对失落的自然反应这一真理深深契合。即使是道成肉身的雅伟，也曾为朋友的离世而哭泣，这表明悲伤并非软弱，而是爱与人性的深刻表达。他能够承认并承受自己的悲伤，而非压抑它，这体现了一种在拥抱人类情感全貌中找到的平静力量。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Guardian-produced Gaza documentary from Oscar-winning Israeli directors of No Other Land to screen at Venice film festival
title.zh: Guardian制作的加沙纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演执导，将在威尼斯电影节上映

summary.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham...
summary.zh: 由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔（与巴塞尔·阿德拉和哈姆丹·巴拉尔共同执导《无他之地》）执导的《卫报》制作的加沙纪录片，将调查战争期间“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”，并将在威尼斯电影节首映。这部名为《NAZA》的电影由吉姆·威尔逊制作，乔纳森·格雷泽（《利益区域》团队）担任执行制片人，是今...

body.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is to receive its world premiere at the Venice film festival. The film, called NAZA, has been produced with Jim Wilson and executive produced by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind The Zone of Interest, and is the only documentary that will compete this year for Venice’s prestigious Golden Lion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary, "NAZA," premiering at the Venice Film Festival, seeks to bring to light the alleged "calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians" in Gaza. In a world where many suffer in silence, such efforts to investigate and expose injustice embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. Yahweh's word reminds us of the...
reflection.zh: 这部名为《NAZA》的纪录片将在威尼斯电影节首映，旨在揭露加沙地带“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”。在一个许多人默默承受苦难的世界里，这种调查和揭露不公的努力，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召。雅伟的话语提醒我们，为贫困者的权利发声并确保他们的故事被听见，是一项道德责任。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: How the mob took Hollywood: the story of organized crime and the movies
title.zh: 黑帮如何掌控好莱坞：有组织犯罪与电影的故事

summary.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series,...
summary.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮掌控电影业》回顾了犯罪分子如何渗透电影业。该三部曲纪录片的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森称：“从好莱坞创立之初，有组织犯罪就已存在。”

body.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series, Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies. Organized crime’s connection to the film industry actually predates Tinseltown, being present for the foundation of the medium itself, when inventor Thomas Edison sicced his hired goons on competitors in an attempt to maintain total control over early motion picture technology. As covered in Hollywood Crime Story, this resulted in said competitors – mostly Jewish businessmen from the east coast – fleeing westward and establishing the town and studio system that would become synonymous with movies as we know them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》回顾了犯罪分子如何潜入电影行业“从好莱坞的根基开始，有组织的犯罪就在那里。”新的三集纪录片系列《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森如是说。有组织犯罪与电影业的联系实际上早于好莱坞，当时发明家托马斯·爱迪生（Thomas Edison）为了保持对早期电影技术的完全控制，而雇佣了暴徒来对付竞争对手，这一点就为电影本身奠定了基础。正如《好莱坞犯罪故事》中所报道的那样，这导致上述竞争对手（主要是来自东海岸的犹太商人）向西逃亡，并建立了城镇和制片厂系统，该系统将成为我们所知的电影的代名词。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Hollywood Crime Story" reveals how organized crime, driven by the pursuit of wealth and power, embedded itself in the film industry from its very beginning, even with figures like Thomas Edison using "hired goons." This historical account reminds us that the love of money can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, corrupting even creative...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事》揭示了有组织犯罪如何从电影业的早期，甚至从托马斯·爱迪生使用“雇佣打手”开始，就因对财富和权力的追求而渗透其中。这个历史记载提醒我们，贪爱钱财确实是万恶之根，它能腐蚀社会中富有创造力和影响力的领域。这凸显了在面对非法利益的诱惑时，保持正直所需的持续警惕。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
summary.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥主演了一部三集纪录片，由《兄弟：尖叫停止后》的创作者制作。别指望它会那么有趣……这部迷你剧的导演乔·珀尔曼之前的作品包括2018年那部揭露性十足又滑稽的电影，

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: ‘Boorman and the Devil’ Review: This Deep Dive Into How ‘Exorcist II: The Heretic’ Spiraled Out of Control Deserves a Wide Release
title.zh: 《布尔曼与魔鬼》评论：深入探讨《驱魔人 II：异端》如何失控，值得广泛发布

summary.en: David Kittredge conjures a true film lover's retrospective in this magical John Boorman documentary.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自纪录片栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

Editor’s note: This review was originally published on October 24, 2025 out of the 2025 Brooklyn Horror Film Festival. Yellow Veil Pictures will release the film at NYC’s Quad Cinema on Friday, August 28, with expansion to follow.

David Kittredge delivers a dazzling reflection on the career of John Boorman in the documentary “ Boorman and the Devil ,” a robust reframing of the legendary director’s “ Exorcist II: The Heretic ,” as strange and poetic as the disastrous 1977 production itself.

These days, Boorman’s much-maligned sequel to William Friedkin’s supernatural masterpiece is best known as a string of memes. You’ve got James Earl Jones dressed as a giant locust . Linda Blair tap-dancing her demons away . Even the film’s core concept of The Synchronizer, a baffling psychic invention from the script that not only vexed audiences but forced unionized crew members to debate whether the thing was a light or a prop. Related Stories ‘The Dog Stars’ Review: Jacob Elordi and Josh Brolin Can’t Save Ridley Scott’s Bizarrely Inert Post-Apocalypse Movie from Near-Disaster Dolly Parton, Iconic Singer/Songwriter and ‘9 to 5’ Star, Dies at 80

An embarrassment of riches for behind-the-scenes factoids, “Exorcist II: The Heretic” is a lot more than a punchline and as memorable as any real train wreck. If you already like the 1977 movie (and I’ll tell you right now, you should !), then “Boorman and the Devil” might not make the argument that it’s objectively good as fiercely as you’d like . But for those who hate “Exorcist II” or just haven’t seen it, Kittredge provides a sparkling on-ramp to New Hollywood history and Boorman’s astonishing career. (Note: The film also features IndieWire’s Jim Hemphill as a talking head.)

92 years old now, Boorman debuted in black-and-white with “Catch Us If You Can” (1965), before canoeing to the Oscars with Jon Voight in “Deliverance” (1972) and blasting off into batshit space with Sean Connery and a fur bikini for “Zardoz” (1974) . At the top of his game when he was offered the chance to direct the original “Exorcist” over Friedkin, the British cinephile declined, and embraced his own original and audacious visions instead. By the time the studio system circled back to Boorman on “Exorcist II,” Hollywood was amid a...

title.en: ‘NAZA’ Documentary from ‘No Other Land’ Directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor Sets North American Premiere at NYFF
title.zh: 《NAZA》纪录片——《无他之地》导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和瑞秋·索尔的作品，将在纽约电影节北美首映

summary.en: The documentary 'NAZA,' directed by Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, will have its North American premiere at the New York Film Festival after its world premiere in Venice. The film focuses on Israeli military operations in Gaza.
summary.zh: 由以色列电影制作人尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和瑞秋·索尔执导的纪录片《NAZA》将在威尼斯国际电影节进行世界首映后，于纽约电影节进行北美首映。该片聚焦于以色列在加沙的军事行动。

body.en:

Just when it seemed like the 2026 New York Film Festival lineup was complete, another major film has been added to the 64th edition.

“ NAZA ,” a new documentary about the war in Gaza from Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, will make its North American premiere at NYFF . The Lincoln Center screening will follow its world premiere at the Venice International Film Festival.

Abraham and Szor served as two of the four directors of the critically acclaimed (and inevitably controversial) 2024 documentary “No Other Land.” They shared directing duties with Palestinian filmmakers Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal. That Oscar-winning film was notable for its collaboration between Palestinian and Israeli artists and its unapologetic support for the Palestinian cause. Related Stories Ridley Scott Reveals Lost ‘Blade Runner’ Script Idea That Proved Too Complicated, and Why Harrison Ford ‘Didn’t Get’ the Movie ‘The Dog Stars’ Review: Jacob Elordi and Josh Brolin Can’t Save Ridley Scott’s Bizarrely Inert Post-Apocalypse Movie from Near-Disaster

While Abraham and Szor are working by themselves this time around, “NAZA” explores similar subject matter. Shot on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, the new film takes a closer look at the practices of the Israeli Defense Forces, taking its title from a military term for the number of civilian casualties that are expected from a given operation.

“NAZA” is produced by The Guardian and James Wilson for JW Films. Jonathan Glazer also serves as an executive producer on the film. Wilson notably produced Glazer’s most recent film, “The Zone of Interest.”

“’NAZA’ is an important investigative documentary about one of the gravest catastrophes of our time. The film brings critical information to light and, through its singular cinematic language, prompts broader questions of individual and societal complicity and accountability, especially in a time of intersecting global conflicts and endless wars,” NYFF artistic director Dennis Lim said in a statement. “Like many films in this year’s NYFF slate, it demonstrates cinema’s enduring ability to reflect and engage with the world around us.”

reflection.en: The documentary 'NAZA' brings the realities of Israeli military operations in Gaza to the screen, prompting reflection on the enduring cycles of conflict. As we witness these events, the ancient call to 'not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good' (Romans 12:21) resonates deeply, urging a path beyond retaliation towards healing and peace.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《NAZA》将以色列在加沙的军事行动的现实呈现在银幕上，引人深思冲突的持久循环。当我们目睹这些事件时，那古老的呼唤“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶”（罗马书12:21）产生了深刻的共鸣，敦促我们超越报复，走向疗愈与和平。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: ‘Environmental violence’: inside the fight to save indigenous land from becoming a nuclear dumping ground
title.zh: “环境暴力”：在保护原住民土地免遭核废料倾倒的斗争中

summary.en: The new documentary 'To Use a Mountain' showcases the struggles and successes of indigenous communities resisting government plans to designate parts of the rural US as nuclear waste disposal sites. The film touches upon the complex history of nuclear energy, initially presented as a solution but fraught with safety...
summary.zh: 新纪录片《使用一座山》展示了原住民社区在抵制政府将美国乡村部分地区指定为核废料处理场计划中所经历的斗争和取得的成功。该片触及了核能复杂的历史，它最初被誉为解决方案，但却伴随着安全隐患和环境影响。

body.en: New documentary To Use a Mountain spotlights the pain and triumph of resisting government efforts to turn parts of rural US into disposal sites Nuclear energy was supposed to be our salvation, humanity’s chance to retool technology first conceived as a weapon of mass destruction into an engine of limitless prosperity. But even as the industry touted nuclear fission as an economic game-changer (never mind the astronomical startup costs ), a safety paragon (never mind the spills at Chornobyl , Three Mile Island and Fukushima ) and harmless fodder for an American comedy institution (never mind that glowing rod on Homer’s back or the three-eyed fish), there was no getting around the matter of what to do with all the toxic waste (never mind nuclear’s claimed green credentials). The stagnant state of that dirty business brought Casey Carter, the director of the new avant-garde documentary called To Use a Mountain , back to his interview with a Washington state farmer who was part of a class-action lawsuit against the government over the release of radioactive material from the Hanford nuclear reservation – site of the world’s first full-scale plutonium production reactor. The farmer’s words still echo, despite ultimately being cut to fit the film’s 90-minute runtime. “He joked that nuclear power is the only faith-based energy because everyone always asks, ‘Do you believe in it?’” Carter says. “He was like, ‘You don’t have to believe in solar. It’s just a pretty good idea.’” Continue reading...
body.zh: 新纪录片《利用一座山》聚焦了抵制政府将美国部分农村地区变成处置场的努力的痛苦和胜利。核能被认为是我们的救赎，人类有机会将最初被设想为大规模杀伤性武器的技术改造为无限繁荣的引擎。但是，尽管该行业将核裂变吹捧为经济游戏规则的改变者（更不用说天文数字的启动成本）、安全典范（更不用说切尔诺贝利、三哩岛和福岛的泄漏事件）和美国喜剧机构的无害素材（更不用说荷马背上的发光棒或三眼鱼），但仍然无法回避如何处理所有有毒废物的问题（更不用说核能声称绿色凭证）。这一肮脏行业的停滞状态让新前卫纪录片《利用一座山》的导演凯西·卡特回想起他对一位华盛顿州农民的采访，这位农民正参与针对政府的集体诉讼，该诉讼涉及汉福德核保护区（世界上第一个全面的钚生产反应堆所在地）释放放射性物质。尽管最终为了适应影片 90 分钟的时长而进行了剪辑，但这位农民的话仍然令人回响。 “他开玩笑说核能是唯一基于信仰的能源，因为每个人总是问，‘你相信它吗？’”卡特说。 “他说，‘你不必相信太阳能。这只是一个很好的主意。’”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary 'To Use a Mountain' brings to light the profound challenges faced by indigenous communities fighting to protect their ancestral lands from becoming nuclear dumping grounds. Their struggle is a powerful testament to the need to advocate for the voiceless and defend the vulnerable against potentially devastating environmental decisions. It...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《使用一座山》揭示了原住民社区在为保护其祖传土地免遭核废料倾倒而进行的斗争中所面临的严峻挑战。他们的抗争有力地证明了为那些不能为自己发声的人代言，并为了子孙后代和地球本身的利益，挺身而出对抗可能带来毁灭性环境决策的必要性。它促使我们思考，进步的代价由谁承担，以及为未来世代和地球本身发声的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。
